              <div class="gl-imp" id="glImp" hidden>
                <p class="gl-imp-h">两列即可 —— 原词、译名（第三列可选填词性）。直接粘贴，或选一个文件。</p>
                <textarea class="field gl-ta" id="glPaste" rows="4" spellcheck="false"
                  placeholder="注意力,attention&#10;认知负荷,cognitive load,n."></textarea>
                <div class="gl-imp-row">
                  <label class="gl-file">
                    <input type="file" id="glFile" accept=".csv,.tsv,.txt,text/csv,text/plain" hidden>
                    <span class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm">选择文件</span>
                    <em id="glFileNote">未选择</em>
                  </label>
                  <span class="gl-sep">分隔符</span>
                  <select class="gl-mini" id="glDelim" aria-label="分隔符">
                    <option value="">自动</option>
                    <option value=",">逗号</option>
                    <option value="&#9;">制表符</option>
                    <option value=";">分号</option>
                    <option value="|">竖线</option>
                    <option value="=">等号</option>
                    <option value="：">全角冒号</option>
                  </select>
                  <label class="gl-ck"><input type="checkbox" id="glHeader" checked>首行为表头</label>
                  <span class="gl-sep">重复</span>
                  <label class="gl-ck"><input type="radio" name="glDup" value="skip" checked>跳过</label>
                  <label class="gl-ck"><input type="radio" name="glDup" value="over">覆盖</label>
                </div>
                <p class="gl-pv" id="glPv" aria-live="polite"></p>
                <div class="gl-imp-act">
                  <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" id="glDo" disabled>导入</button>
                  <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" id="glCancel">取消</button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div id="glList" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="词表"></div>
              <div class="gl-add">
                <input class="field" id="glSrc" placeholder="原词，如「注意力」" aria-label="原词">
                <input class="field" id="glDst" placeholder="译名，如 attention" aria-label="译名">
                <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" id="glAdd">添加</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="two-col mt-24">
          <div class="card card-pad">
            <div class="card-title"><span id="icDev"></span>双端设备</div>
            <div class="dev-row">
              <span id="icDesk"></span>
              <div><b>桌面端 · 墨读 InkRead</b><span>Windows · 水墨屏模拟器</span></div>
              <span class="dev-state" id="deskState"></span>
            </div>
            <div class="dev-row">
              <span id="icPhone"></span>
              <div><b>手机端 · 墨读 App</b><span>iOS · 镜像阅读与打卡</span></div>
              <span class="dev-state" id="phoneState"></span>
            </div>
            <p class="sync-warn" id="syncWarn" hidden></p>
            <div class="sync-log">
              <div class="card-note mb-12">最近同步</div>
              <ul id="syncLog"></ul>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="card card-pad">
            <div class="card-title"><span id="icMirror"></span>手机端实时预览<span class="sub">打卡即同步</span></div>
            <div class="phone-wrap">
              <div class="phone">
                <div class="phone-screen">
                  <div class="phone-status">
                    <span id="phTime">08:12</span>
                    <span class="row" style="gap:6px"><span id="phWifi"></span><span id="phBat"></span></span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="phone-head">
                    <b id="phTitle">今日清单</b>
                    <span id="phSub"></span>
                  </div>
                  <div class="phone-body">
                    <div class="relay-chip" id="relayChip"></div>
                    <div class="m-sync-tip" id="mSyncTip">已同步至桌面端</div>
                    <div id="phBody"></div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="phone-tabbar">
                    <button class="ptab active" data-ptab="today"><span id="ptToday"></span>今日</button>
                    <button class="ptab" data-ptab="plan"><span id="ptPlan"></span>计划</button>
                    <button class="ptab" data-ptab="me"><span id="ptMe"></span>我的</button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="card card-pad mt-24">
          <div class="card-title"><span id="icPrompt"></span>提示词<span class="sub" id="pmSub"></span></div>
          <p class="card-note mb-12">软件里每一枚会问模型的功能，怎么问都写在这张表上。改过的只存改动的那几枚，没改的跟着版本一起升级。
            这张表会随同步带到另一台设备 —— 密钥不许写进模板，出现 sk-、api key、token 一类字样会被拦下。</p>
          <div class="pm-wrap">
            <div class="pm-list" id="pmList" aria-label="提示词功能清单"></div>
            <div class="pm-edit" id="pmEdit" hidden>
              <div class="pm-head">
                <b id="pmName"></b><code class="pm-code" id="pmKey"></code>
                <span class="chip" id="pmTag" hidden>已改</span>
              </div>
              <label class="field-label" for="pmText">系统提示词模板</label>
              <textarea class="field pm-ta" id="pmText" rows="14" spellcheck="false"></textarea>
              <ul class="pm-ph" id="pmPh"></ul>
              <div class="pm-params">
                <label>温度<input class="field" id="pmTemp" type="number" step="0.1" min="0" max="2"></label>
                <label>最长回答（字）<input class="field" id="pmMax" type="number" min="1" step="1"></label>
                <label>超时（秒）<input class="field" id="pmTmo" type="number" min="1" step="1"></label>
                <label class="pm-model">模型名（只填名字）<input class="field" id="pmModel" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off"></label>
              </div>
              <p class="field-hint">留空 = 不改这一项，照内置与全局设置走。</p>
              <div class="pm-act">
                <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" id="pmSave">保存覆盖</button>
                <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" id="pmReset">恢复内置</button>
                <span class="spacer"></span>
                <span class="pm-msg card-note" id="pmMsg" role="status" aria-live="polite"></span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="modal-mask" id="modelMask" style="display:none">
  <div class="modal modal-lg">
    <div class="modal-head">
      <h3><span id="icModelTitle"></span>模型设置</h3>
      <button class="modal-x" id="modelX" aria-label="关闭" title="关闭"></button>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-body">
      <label class="field-label">服务商</label>
      <div class="pv-chips" id="pvChips" role="group" aria-label="服务商预设"></div>
      <p class="field-hint" id="pvNote">选预设可自动填好接口地址；密钥与模型名由你决定。</p>

      <label class="field-label" for="mBase">接口地址 · Base URL</label>
      <input class="field" id="mBase" type="url" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off" placeholder="https://api.deepseek.com/v1">
      <p class="field-hint">以 http:// 或 https:// 开头；OpenAI 兼容服务通常以 /v1 结尾。</p>

      <label class="field-label" for="mKey">API Key</label>
      <div class="key-row">
        <input class="field" id="mKey" type="password" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off" placeholder="sk-…">
        <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" id="mKeyEye" aria-label="显示或隐藏密钥"></button>
      </div>
      <p class="field-hint">密钥只存本机浏览器，不随同步上传。</p>

      <label class="field-label" for="mName">模型名称</label>
      <div class="key-row">
        <input class="field" id="mName" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off" placeholder="deepseek-chat"
               role="combobox" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="mNameList" aria-autocomplete="list">
        <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" id="mPull">拉取列表</button>
      </div>
      <p class="field-hint" id="mNameHint">可直接敲字筛选，也可点「拉取列表」从该接口取回真实模型名。</p>

      <div class="hr"></div>
      <div class="adv-head">
        <span class="field-label" style="margin:0">高级参数</span>
        <button class="mpd-mini" id="advToggle" aria-expanded="false">展开 ›</button>
      </div>
      <div id="advBox" hidden>
        <label class="field-label">温度 <span class="card-note" id="tempVal">0.4</span></label>
        <input type="range" class="range" id="tempRange" min="0" max="10" value="4">
        <label class="field-label" for="mTokens">最大输出 tokens</label>
        <input class="field" id="mTokens" type="number" min="256" max="32768" step="256" value="2048">
        <div class="set-row"><span class="sr-k">流式输出（逐字返回）</span><button class="switch on" id="swStream" aria-pressed="true" aria-label="流式输出开关" title="流式输出"></button></div>
      </div>

      <div class="hr"></div>
      <div class="adv-head">
        <span class="field-label" style="margin:0">朗读音色 · 云音色</span>
        <span class="card-note" id="ttsState"></span>
      </div>
      <label class="field-label" for="ttsBase">Moss 接口地址</label>
      <input class="field" id="ttsBase" type="url" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off" placeholder="https://api.mosi.cn/v1">
      <label class="field-label" for="ttsKey">Moss API Key</label>
      <div class="key-row">
        <input class="field" id="ttsKey" type="password" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off" placeholder="留空则只用本机声线">
        <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" id="ttsPull">拉取音色</button>
      </div>
      <label class="field-label" for="ttsModel">TTS 模型</label>
      <input class="field" id="ttsModel" list="ttsModelList" spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off" placeholder="moss-tts-1.5-flash">
      <datalist id="ttsModelList">
        <option value="moss-tts-1.5-flash"></option>
        <option value="moss-tts-1.5-pro"></option>
      </datalist>
      <p class="field-hint">填好密钥后「音色商城」会出现该账号的云音色（Mossland 音色库），音质最好；留空则一律用本机声线，离线可用。</p>

      <div class="mtest" id="mTest" hidden></div>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-foot">
      <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="mTestBtn"><span id="icTestBtn"></span>测试连接</button>
      <span class="spacer"></span>
      <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="modelCancel">取消</button>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="modelOk">保存</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- 模型候选：自绘可搜索列表。原生 <datalist> 三条做不到 —— 不随主题换色、
     无法标注「当前值不在可用列表」、键盘上下与点击不统一。面板挂在 body 下而不是
     .modal 里：.modal 的进场动画带 transform，会把 fixed 后代的定位祖先改成它自己，
     再被弹层容器的 overflow 裁掉。 -->
<div class="mdd" id="mNamePop" hidden>
  <div class="ikp-list" id="mNameList" role="listbox" aria-label="模型候选列表"></div>
  <div class="mdd-foot" id="mNameFoot"></div>
</div>

<div class="toast-root" id="toastRoot" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false"></div>
<script src="mock.js"></script>
<script src="md.js"></script>
<script src="voices-data.js"></script>
<script src="voices.js"></script>
<script src="api.js"></script>
<script src="app.js"></script>
<script src="brain.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var ck = InkStore.getCheckins();
  var state = { ptab: "today" };

  var IC = {
    icSync: "refresh-cw", icModel: "cpu", icModelTitle: "cpu", icSend: "send", icMem: "brain",
    icMemChip: "brain", icCtx: "book-open",
    icCpu: "cpu", icDev: "share-2", icDesk: "monitor", icPhone: "smartphone", icMirror: "smartphone",
    icGloss: "languages", icGlSearch: "search", icPrompt: "quote",
    icTestBtn: "zap",
    icBot: "bot", ptToday: "list-checks", ptPlan: "calendar-days", ptMe: "user", phWifi: "wifi", phBat: "battery"
  };
  Object.keys(IC).forEach(function (id) { var el = qs("#" + id); if (el) el.innerHTML = icon(IC[id], 16); });
  qs("#botAva").innerHTML = icon("sparkles", 18);
  qs("#modelX").innerHTML = icon("x", 18);
  qs("#memX").innerHTML = icon("x", 14);
  /* 手机预览状态条接真实本机状态（镜像语义：所见即当前设备实况） */
  function paintPhoneStatus() {
    var on = navigator.onLine !== false;
    qs("#phWifi").innerHTML = icon(on ? "wifi" : "wifi-off", 12);
    var bat = qs("#phBat");
    if (navigator.getBattery) {
      navigator.getBattery().then(function (b) {
        bat.innerHTML = icon(b.charging ? "battery-charging" : "battery", 12) +
          "<em style='font-style:normal;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:10px'>" +
          Math.round(b.level * 100) + "%</em>";
      }).catch(function () { bat.style.display = "none"; });   /* v2.11 C：取不到就藏，不留有形无值的空图标 */
    } else {
      bat.style.display = "none";
    }
  }
  paintPhoneStatus();
  window.addEventListener("online", paintPhoneStatus);
  window.addEventListener("offline", paintPhoneStatus);

  var daily = DB.tasks.filter(function (t) { return t.kind === "daily"; });
  function done(id) { return !!ck[id]; }

  /* ============ 上下文：对话聚焦哪本书 ============ */
  function memAll() { return (window.Brain && Brain.memories && Brain.memories()) || []; }
  function ctxDoc() { return state.ctxDoc || ""; }

  function renderCtx() {
    var sel = qs("#ctxDoc");
    var list = (window.shelfList ? shelfList() : (DB.shelf || []));
    sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">全部书架</option>' + list.map(function (d) {
      return '<option value="' + esc(d.id) + '">' + esc(d.title) + "</option>";
    }).join("");
    sel.value = ctxDoc();
    sel.addEventListener("change", function () {
      state.ctxDoc = sel.value || "";
      if (window.Brain) Brain.setDoc(state.ctxDoc || null);
      renderChatSub();
      toast(state.ctxDoc ? "上下文 · 聚焦《" + (Brain.docTitle(state.ctxDoc) || "未收录文档") + "》" : "上下文 · 全部书架", "brain");
    });
  }

  /* 在线 / 离线：不是装饰，是「答案从哪来」的交代 */
  function renderChatSub() {
    var online = !!(window.Brain && Brain.online && Brain.online());
    var cfg = online ? (API.modelCfg() || {}) : {};
    qs("#chatSub").textContent = online ? ("在线 · " + (cfg.model || "已接入模型")) : "离线 · 仅用本机离线库";
    var st = qs("#chatState");
    st.className = "chip " + (online ? "chip-green" : "chip-amber");
    st.innerHTML = icon(online ? "wifi" : "wifi-off", 12) + (online ? "在线" : "离线");
  }

  /* ============ 对话 ============ */
  function msgEl(role, html) {
    var d = new Date();
    var hm = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, "0") + ":" + String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0");
    return '<div class="msg ' + role + '">' + html + '<span class="msg-time">' + hm + "</span></div>";
  }

  /* 记忆短标签：取首句（逗号前），足够在引用条里认出是哪一条 */
  function memLabel(text) {
    var s = String(text || "").split(/[，,；;。]/)[0].trim();
    return s.length > 18 ? s.slice(0, 18) + "…" : s;
  }

  /* 引用条：答案下面诚实标出「这次用到了哪几条记忆」。
     ids 为 null 表示这轮没走记忆（例如打招呼），不贴引用条。 */
  function memRefsHTML(ids) {
    if (ids == null) return "";
    var list = (ids || []).map(function (id) {
      return memAll().find(function (m) { return m.id === id; });
    }).filter(function (m) { return m && m.on !== false; });
    if (!list.length) {
      return '<div class="msg-ref none" data-refs="' + esc((ids || []).join(",")) + '">' + icon("brain", 12) + "未参考记忆</div>";
    }
    var chips = list.map(function (m) {
      return '<button class="mr-chip" data-mem="' + m.id + '" title="' + esc(m.why || m.text) + '">' + esc(memLabel(m.text)) + "</button>";
    }).join("");
    return '<div class="msg-ref" data-refs="' + esc((ids || []).join(",")) + '">' + icon("brain", 12) + "参考 " + list.length + " 条记忆" +
      '<span class="mr-chips">' + chips + "</span></div>";
  }

  /* 答案来源徽标：在线（哪个模型）/ 离线（用了离线库的哪几部分） */
  function modeHTML(r) {
    if (!r) return "";
    /* v2.2：记忆指令的回执徽标（记住 / 忘掉 / 清单 / 未匹配） */
    if (r.mode === "memory") {
      var label = { remember: "记忆 · 已写入", forget: "记忆 · 已删除", list: "记忆 · 当前清单", miss: "记忆 · 未匹配" }[r.action] || "记忆";
      return '<div class="msg-mode on">' + icon("database", 11) + esc(label) + "</div>";
    }
    var online = r.mode === "online";
    var txt = online ? ("主脑 · " + (r.model || "模型")) : "离线库作答" + (r.used && r.used.length ? " · " + r.used.join("/") : "");
    /* 随问附上多少原文要看得见（v1.3 D4）：数字就是真发出去的那一份；
       一段都没带时写「未附原文」，不能整条省略 —— 省略了读者只能猜，猜错就以为带了。 */
    if (online) {
      txt += r.ctxChars
        ? " · 随问附上 " + r.ctxChars.toLocaleString("zh-CN") + " 字原文" + (r.ctxItems > 1 ? "（" + r.ctxItems + " 段）" : "")
        : " · 本次未附原文";
      if (r.net) txt += " · " + API.retryNote(r.net);
    }
    return '<div class="msg-mode ' + (online ? "on" : "off") + '">' + icon(online ? "sparkles" : "wifi-off", 11) + esc(txt) + "</div>";
  }

  function pushMsg(role, text, refs, r) {
    var box = qs("#chatMsgs");
    var html = role === "ai" ? MD.render(text) + memRefsHTML(refs) + modeHTML(r) : esc(text);
    box.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", msgEl(role, html));
    box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
    bindRefChips();
  }

  function bindRefChips() {
    qsa(".mr-chip", qs("#chatMsgs")).forEach(function (b) {
      if (b.dataset.bound) return;
      b.dataset.bound = "1";
      b.addEventListener("click", function () { openMem(b.dataset.mem); });
    });
  }

  function typing(on) {
    var box = qs("#chatMsgs");
    var t = qs("#typingRow");
    if (on) {
      if (t) return;
      box.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", '<div class="msg ai" id="typingRow"><span class="typing"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span></div>');
      box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
    } else if (t) t.remove();
  }

  /* 流式：先立一个空壳，模型吐一段就重画一段 —— 长答案不用干等 */
  function pushStreaming(role) {
    var box = qs("#chatMsgs");
    box.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", msgEl(role, '<div class="stream-body"></div>'));
    var el = box.lastElementChild;
    box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
    return el;
  }
  function paintStreaming(el, text) {
    var b = el.querySelector(".stream-body");
    if (b) b.innerHTML = MD.render(text || "");
    var box = qs("#chatMsgs");
    box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
  }
  function finalizeStreaming(el, text, refs, r) {
    var b = el.querySelector(".stream-body");
    var tail = memRefsHTML(refs) + modeHTML(r);
    if (b) b.outerHTML = MD.render(text || "") + tail;
    else el.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", MD.render(text || "") + tail);
    bindRefChips();
  }

  /* 开场白：由真实状态现算，不是预置文案 */
  function greet() {
    var name = window.InkProfile ? InkProfile.name() : "读者";
    var h = new Date().getHours();
    var hi = h < 6 ? "夜深了" : h < 11 ? "早上好" : h < 14 ? "中午好" : h < 18 ? "下午好" : "晚上好";
    var dn = daily.filter(function (t) { return done(t.id); }).length;
    var mems = memAll().filter(function (m) { return m.on !== false; });
    var bits = [hi + "，" + name + "。"];
    if (daily.length) bits.push("今日清单 " + dn + "/" + daily.length + " 项已打卡。");
    var cur = ctxDoc();
    if (cur) { var dm = window.Brain && Brain.docMeta(cur); if (dm) bits.push("我正看着《" + dm.title + "》。"); }
    bits.push(mems.length ? ("从你的行为里学到了 " + mems.length + " 条记忆，回答时会带上。") : "我还不太认识你 —— 多读几页、划几条高亮，我会自己看出来。");
    bits.push(window.Brain && Brain.online() ? "有什么想问的直接说。" : "现在没接模型，我离线只用本机离线库作答；接上模型后我就有那个模型的全部能力。");
    return bits.join("");
  }

  var QUICK = ["总结当前文档", "这本书讲了什么", "我的记忆有哪些", "帮我调整本周计划", "解释「注意力机制」"];
  qs("#chatQuick").innerHTML = QUICK.map(function (q) { return '<button class="chip chip-btn" data-q="' + esc(q) + '">' + esc(q) + "</button>"; }).join("");
  qsa("#chatQuick .chip-btn").forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener("click", function () { send(b.dataset.q); });
  });

  var busy = false;
  async function send(text) {
    if (busy) return;
    text = (text || qs("#chatInput").value).trim();
    if (!text) return;
    qs("#chatInput").value = "";
    pushMsg("me", text);
    busy = true;
    typing(true);
    var holder = null;
    try {
      var r = await Brain.ask(text, {
        docId: ctxDoc(),
        onDelta: function (piece, all) {
          if (!holder) { typing(false); holder = pushStreaming("ai"); }
          paintStreaming(holder, all);
        }
      });
      /* r.note：模型请求失败、brain.js 已改用离线库作答 —— 原因必须让用户看见，
         否则会把降级后的离线答案当成模型给的（v2.22 主脑错误态）。 */
      var shown = r.note ? r.reply + "\n\n> " + r.note : r.reply;
      if (holder) finalizeStreaming(holder, shown, r.refs, r);
      else { typing(false); pushMsg("ai", shown, r.refs, r); }
    } catch (e) {
      typing(false);
      if (holder) holder.remove();
      pushMsg("ai", "主脑出错了：" + ((e && e.message) || "未知错误") + "。\n\n可到右侧「模型设置」检查接口地址与密钥；离线时我仍能用本机离线库作答。");
    }
    busy = false;
    InkFX.flash();
    renderMemory();
  }

  qs("#chatSend").addEventListener("click", function () { send(); });
  qs("#chatInput").addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Enter") send(); });

  /* ============ 记忆（主脑从行为中学到的，带证据） ============
     入口只有两个：对话头部的「N 条记忆」按钮、答案里的记忆引用条。
     开关即时落库并同步刷新引用条与计数；「忘掉」是真删除（两击确认）。 */
  var memPop = qs("#memPop"), memBtn = qs("#memBtn");

  function renderMemory() {
    var list = memAll();
    var on = list.filter(function (m) { return m.on !== false; }).length;
    qs("#memBtnN").textContent = on;
    qs("#memSub").textContent = list.length ? (on + " / " + list.length + " 条已启用") : "尚无记忆";
    if (!list.length) {
      qs("#memList").innerHTML = '<p class="mem-empty">主脑还没从你的行为里学到什么。多读几页、划几条高亮、打几次卡、建几条术语 —— 证据攒够了，记忆会自己长出来。</p>';
      return;
    }
    qs("#memList").innerHTML = list.map(function (m) {
      var conf = Math.round((m.conf || 0) * 100);
      return '<div class="mem-row" data-row="' + m.id + '">' +
        '<div class="mem-main">' +
          '<div class="mem-text">' + esc(m.text) + "</div>" +
          '<div class="mem-meta"><span class="mem-src">' + esc(m.src || "行为") + '</span>' +
            '<span class="mem-conf" title="置信度">' + conf + '%</span>' +
            (m.at ? '<span class="mem-at">' + esc(m.at) + "</span>" : "") + "</div>" +
          (m.why ? '<div class="mem-why">' + esc(m.why) + "</div>" : "") +
        "</div>" +
        '<div class="mem-act">' +
          '<button class="switch' + (m.on !== false ? " on" : "") + '" data-mem="' + m.id + '" role="switch" aria-checked="' + (m.on !== false ? "true" : "false") + '" aria-label="启用或停用这条记忆"></button>' +
          '<button class="mem-edit" data-edit="' + m.id + '" aria-label="编辑这条记忆" title="编辑文本">' + icon("pen-line", 13) + "</button>" +
          '<button class="mem-del" data-forget="' + m.id + '" aria-label="忘掉这条记忆" title="忘掉（删除）">' + icon("trash-2", 13) + "</button>" +
        "</div></div>";
    }).join("");

    qsa("#memList .switch").forEach(function (s) {
      s.addEventListener("click", async function () {
        var m = memAll().find(function (x) { return x.id === s.dataset.mem; });
        if (!m) return;
        var next = m.on === false;
        await API.saveMemoryToggle(s.dataset.mem, next);
        renderMemory();
        repaintRefs();
        toast(next ? "记忆已启用" : "记忆已停用", "brain");
      });
    });

    /* 忘掉 = 真的删除，两击确认，不用系统弹窗 */
    qsa("#memList .mem-del").forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener("click", async function () {
        if (b.dataset.arm !== "1") {
          b.dataset.arm = "1";
          b.classList.add("arm");
          b.title = "再点一次确认忘掉";
          setTimeout(function () { b.dataset.arm = ""; b.classList.remove("arm"); b.title = "忘掉（删除）"; }, 2600);
          return;
        }
        await API.forgetMemory(b.dataset.forget);
        renderMemory();
        repaintRefs();
        toast("已忘掉这条记忆", "brain");
      });
    });

    /* v2.2 · 编辑记忆：点铅笔 → 文本行内可改 → 回车/失焦保存，Esc 放弃。
       调研对齐（ChatGPT Memory：让用户能纠正推断出的结论，是信任的一半）。 */
    qsa("#memList .mem-edit").forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var row = b.closest(".mem-row");
        var t = row && row.querySelector(".mem-text");
        if (!t || t.isContentEditable) return;
        var before = t.textContent;
        t.setAttribute("contenteditable", "true");
        t.classList.add("editing");
        t.focus();
        try {
          var rng = document.createRange();
          rng.selectNodeContents(t); rng.collapse(false);
          var sel = window.getSelection();
          sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(rng);
        } catch (e) {}
        var finish = function (save) {
          t.removeAttribute("contenteditable");
          t.classList.remove("editing");
          var v = String(t.textContent || "").trim();
          if (!save || !v || v === before) { t.textContent = before; return; }
          var list = memAll().map(function (x) {
            return x.id === b.dataset.edit ? Object.assign({}, x, { text: v, edited: true }) : x;
          });
          if (window.API && API.memWrite) API.memWrite(list);
          renderMemory();
          repaintRefs();
          toast("记忆已更新", "pen-line");
        };
        t.addEventListener("blur", function () { finish(true); }, { once: true });
        t.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
          if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); t.blur(); }
          else if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); t.textContent = before; t.blur(); }
        });
      });
    });
  }

  /* v2.2 · 导出记忆：JSON 备份（与「本机数据」整包导出互补，这里是记忆单件） */
  if (qs("#memExport")) {
    qs("#memExport").innerHTML = icon("download", 13);
    qs("#memExport").addEventListener("click", function () {
      var list = memAll();
      var blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify({ app: "inkread", kind: "memories", exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(), memories: list }, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
      var a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = "inkread-memories.json";
      a.click();
      setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); }, 3000);
      toast("已导出 " + list.length + " 条记忆", "download");
    });
  }

  /* 记忆开关一变，已经贴在答案下面的引用条要跟着重画 —— 否则会显示「参考了已停用的记忆」 */
  function repaintRefs() {
    qsa("#chatMsgs .msg.ai").forEach(function (el) {
      var ref = el.querySelector(".msg-ref");
      if (!ref) return;
      var ids = (ref.dataset.refs || "").split(",").filter(Boolean);
      ref.outerHTML = memRefsHTML(ids);
    });
    bindRefChips();
  }

  function openMem(focusId) {
    memPop.hidden = false;
    memBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
    if (focusId) {
      var row = qs('#memList .mem-row[data-row="' + focusId + '"]');
      if (row) {
        row.classList.add("on");
        row.scrollIntoView({ block: "center" });
        setTimeout(function () { row.classList.remove("on"); }, 1600);
      }
    }
  }
  function closeMem() { memPop.hidden = true; memBtn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false"); }

  memBtn.addEventListener("click", function () { memPop.hidden ? openMem() : closeMem(); });
  qs("#memX").addEventListener("click", closeMem);
  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (memPop.hidden) return;
    if (memPop.contains(e.target) || memBtn.contains(e.target)) return;
    if (e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".mr-chip")) return;
    closeMem();
  });
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Escape" && !memPop.hidden) closeMem(); });

  /* ============ 模型配置：预设 + 自定义导入 ============
     流程（调研 Chatbox / LobeChat / SillyTavern 后取齐）：
     ① 选服务商 → 自动填好接口地址；② 填 API Key；③ 填或拉取模型名；
     ④ 测试连通；⑤ 保存。必填三项之外都收进「高级参数」，默认不展开。 */
  /* 配置必须开局就是完整对象：fetchModelConfig() 要等一拍才回来，
     在这一拍里点「模型设置」会当场解引用空配置、弹层永远打不开。 */
  var MC = API.modelCfg();        /* 已保存的配置 */
  var draft = null;     /* 弹层草稿，取消即丢弃 */
  var mask = qs("#modelMask");
  var POOL = [];        /* 当前模型候选：预设给的常用名，或刚从接口拉回来的真实列表 */
  var POOL_FROM = "";   /* 候选从哪来，写进面板脚注 —— 「12 个」得说清是谁给的 */
  var poolRows = [];    /* 面板里按输入过滤后渲染出来的行 */
  var poolSel = -1;     /* 键盘高亮行（-1 = 没有） */
  /* 过滤词只由「敲字」产生。输入框里已有值不等于在筛选：点「拉取列表」回来的
     第一件事是把首个模型名填进框里，若拿它当过滤词，12 个候选会当场塌成 2 个，
     用户看到的是「列表拉不到几个」而不是「已选好一个」。 */
  var poolQ = "";
  var LAST_OK = 0;      /* 最近一次测通的时刻 */

  /* 服务商识别走归一化 host：多一个 /v1、大写、尾斜杠都不该掉成「自定义」——
     一旦掉下去，预设高亮没了、候选也空了，用户只看到「要自己敲地址」。 */
  function providerOf(cfg) {
    var ps = (cfg && cfg.presets) || [];
    var k = API.modelPresetKey(cfg && cfg.baseUrl);
    var hit = k && ps.filter(function (p) { return p.k === k; })[0];
    return hit || { k: "custom", name: "自定义", baseUrl: "", models: [] };
  }

  /* 失败分类 → 下一步做什么。只报一个 HTTP 状态码等于没报。 */
  var KIND_HINT = {
    auth: "密钥与接口地址不匹配：确认这把 Key 属于该服务商，复制时别带空格或换行。",
    network: "地址或端口不通：本地 Ollama 请先确认已在运行；云端请核对 Base URL 的结尾。",
    cors: "浏览器直连被跨域拦截：改用桌面版墨读，或用 node scripts/serve.js 起开发服务（自带本机透传）。",
    unsupported: "该服务没有 /models 列表端点：手填模型名即可，「测试连接」会改用一次最小对话验证连通。"
  };
  function testedAgo() {
    var m = Math.round((Date.now() - LAST_OK) / 60000);
    return m < 1 ? "刚刚测通" : m < 60 ? m + " 分钟前测通" : Math.round(m / 60) + " 小时前测通";
  }
  function presetOf(k) {
    return (MC.presets || []).filter(function (p) { return p.k === k; })[0] ||
      { k: "custom", name: "自定义", baseUrl: "", models: [] };
  }
  function maskKey(k) {
    k = String(k || "");
    if (!k) return "未填写";
    return k.length <= 8 ? k.slice(0, 2) + "···" : k.slice(0, 3) + "···" + k.slice(-4);
  }

  function renderModelCard() {
    var p = providerOf(MC);
    qs("#mmSub").textContent = p.name;
    qs("#mmNow").innerHTML =
      '<div class="mm-row"><span class="mm-k">接口</span><span class="mm-v">' + esc(MC.baseUrl || "未填写") + "</span></div>" +
      '<div class="mm-row"><span class="mm-k">模型</span><span class="mm-v">' + esc(MC.model || "未填写") + "</span></div>" +
      '<div class="mm-row"><span class="mm-k">密钥</span><span class="mm-v">' + esc(maskKey(MC.key)) + "</span></div>";
    qs("#mmHint").textContent = !MC.key ? "尚未填写 API Key"
      : LAST_OK ? "已保存 · " + (MC.model || "未填写") + " · " + testedAgo() + " · 密钥只存本机"
      : "密钥只存本机";
    qs("#chatSub").innerHTML = icon("cloud", 12) + esc(p.name + " · " + (MC.model || "未配置")) + " · 记忆已接入";
  }

  function paintChips() {
    qs("#pvChips").innerHTML = (MC.presets || []).map(function (p) {
      return '<button type="button" class="pv-chip' + (p.k === draft.preset ? " on" : "") +
        '" data-pv="' + p.k + '" aria-pressed="' + (p.k === draft.preset) + '">' + esc(p.name) + "</button>";
    }).join("");
    qsa("[data-pv]", qs("#pvChips")).forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener("click", function () { usePreset(b.dataset.pv); });
    });
    var cur = presetOf(draft.preset);
    qs("#pvNote").textContent = (draft.preset === "custom" || !cur.baseUrl)
      ? "自定义：接口地址、密钥、模型名都由你填写。"
      : cur.name + "：接口地址已填好，密钥与模型名请自行确认。";
    if (!qs("#mNamePop").hidden) renderPool();
  }

  /* 点预设只补地址与候选模型名；已填过的地址不覆盖，免得抹掉用户手改的内容 */
  function usePreset(k) {
    var p = presetOf(k);
    draft.preset = k;
    if (p.baseUrl) { draft.baseUrl = p.baseUrl; qs("#mBase").value = p.baseUrl; }
    setPool(p.models || [], "预设 " + p.name + " 常用模型");
    var typed = qs("#mName").value.trim();
    if (p.models && p.models.length && p.models.indexOf(typed) < 0) {
      draft.model = p.models[0];
      qs("#mName").value = p.models[0];
    }
    paintChips();
  }

  /* 地址是用户从服务商官网粘来的 —— 认得出是谁，就把规范化地址、预设高亮、
     常用模型名一次补齐（force 时才改写输入框，敲字中途不动它）。
     认不出也必须说实话：把地址从 DeepSeek 改成自家网关/本地 Ollama 之后，
     卡片上还写着「DeepSeek」比写着「自定义」更误导人。 */
  function syncProvider(force) {
    var k = API.modelPresetKey(qs("#mBase").value) || "custom";
    if (!draft) return "";
    if (k !== draft.preset) {
      draft.preset = k;
      var p = presetOf(k);
      setPool(p.models || [], "预设 " + p.name + " 常用模型");
      if (!qs("#mName").value.trim() && p.models && p.models.length) qs("#mName").value = p.models[0];
    }
    if (force && k !== "custom") {
      var pb = presetOf(k).baseUrl;
      if (pb) { draft.baseUrl = pb; qs("#mBase").value = pb; }
    }
    paintChips();
    return k;
  }

  function setPool(list, from) {
    POOL = (list || []).filter(function (m) { return typeof m === "string" && m; });
    POOL_FROM = from || "";
    poolSel = -1;
    poolQ = "";
    if (!qs("#mNamePop").hidden) renderPool();
  }
  function inPool(v) {
    var s = String(v || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    return !!s && POOL.some(function (m) { return m.toLowerCase() === s; });
  }

  /* ============ 模型候选面板 ============
     自绘可搜索列表：随主题换色、键盘上下与点击同一套行样式（借 .ikp-item），
     并且能如实标出「当前值不在可用列表」再给一枚「改用」—— datalist 三样都做不到。 */
  function hi(m) {
    var q = poolQ.trim();
    if (!q) return esc(m);
    var i = m.toLowerCase().indexOf(q.toLowerCase());
    if (i < 0) return esc(m);
    return esc(m.slice(0, i)) + '<span class="mdd-mark">' + esc(m.slice(i, i + q.length)) + "</span>" + esc(m.slice(i + q.length));
  }
  function renderPool() {
    var cur = qs("#mName").value.trim();
    var q = poolQ.trim().toLowerCase();
    poolRows = POOL.filter(function (m) { return !q || m.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0; });
    if (poolSel >= poolRows.length) poolSel = poolRows.length - 1;
    var html = "";
    if (cur && !inPool(cur)) {
      html += '<div class="mdd-cur">' + icon("alert-triangle", 13) +
        "<span>当前值 <b>" + esc(cur) + "</b> 不在可用列表</span>" +
        (POOL[0] ? '<button type="button" class="mdd-use" data-m="' + esc(POOL[0]) + '">改用 ' + esc(POOL[0]) + "</button>" : "") +
        "</div>";
    }
    html += poolRows.map(function (m, i) {
      return '<div class="ikp-item' + (i === poolSel ? " on" : "") + '" role="option" data-m="' + esc(m) +
        '" aria-selected="' + (i === poolSel) + '"><span class="ikp-t">' + hi(m) + "</span>" +
        (m.toLowerCase() === cur.toLowerCase() ? icon("check", 13) : "") + "</div>";
    }).join("");
    if (!html) html = '<div class="ikp-empty">没有匹配的模型 —— 直接手填也行</div>';
    qs("#mNameList").innerHTML = html;
    qs("#mNameFoot").textContent = POOL.length
      ? POOL_FROM + " · 共 " + POOL.length + " 个 · ↑↓ 选择 · Enter 确认 · Esc 关闭"
      : "尚无候选 · 点「拉取列表」从接口取回真实模型名，或直接手填";
  }
  function placePool() {
    var pop = qs("#mNamePop");
    var r = qs("#mName").getBoundingClientRect();
    var w = Math.max(Math.round(r.width), 260);
    pop.style.width = w + "px";
    var h = pop.offsetHeight || 0;
    var left = Math.max(8, Math.min(r.left, window.innerWidth - w - 8));
    var top = r.bottom + 6;
    if (top + h > window.innerHeight - 8) top = Math.max(8, r.top - h - 6);  /* 底下放不下就朝上开 */
    pop.style.left = left + "px";
    pop.style.top = Math.round(top) + "px";
  }
  function openPool() {
    if (mask.style.display !== "grid" || !qs("#mNamePop").hidden) return;
    renderPool();
    qs("#mNamePop").hidden = false;
    placePool();
    qs("#mName").setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
  }
  function closePool() {
    if (qs("#mNamePop").hidden) return;
    qs("#mNamePop").hidden = true;
    qs("#mName").setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    poolSel = -1;
  }
  function moveSel(d) {
    if (qs("#mNamePop").hidden) openPool();
    if (!poolRows.length) return;
    poolSel = (poolSel + d + poolRows.length) % poolRows.length;
    renderPool();
    var list = qs("#mNameList");
    var it = list.querySelectorAll(".ikp-item")[poolSel];
    if (!it) return;
    if (it.offsetTop < list.scrollTop) list.scrollTop = it.offsetTop;
    else if (it.offsetTop + it.offsetHeight > list.scrollTop + list.clientHeight)
      list.scrollTop = it.offsetTop + it.offsetHeight - list.clientHeight;
  }
  /* 选中一个模型名：改完立刻落盘（前提是这轮已经测通过），
     否则卡片上写的和候选里点的会各说一套。 */
  function pickPool(m) {
    qs("#mName").value = m;
    poolQ = "";
    closePool();
    if (LAST_OK) saveTested(readForm());
  }

  function openModel() {
    draft = {
      preset: providerOf(MC).k, baseUrl: MC.baseUrl, key: MC.key, model: MC.model,
      temp: MC.temp, maxTokens: MC.maxTokens, stream: MC.stream !== false
    };
    var t = draft.temp == null ? 0.4 : draft.temp;
    qs("#mBase").value = draft.baseUrl || "";
    qs("#mKey").value = draft.key || "";
    qs("#mKey").type = "password";
    qs("#mKeyEye").innerHTML = icon("eye", 14);
    qs("#mName").value = draft.model || "";
    qs("#tempRange").value = Math.round(t * 10);
    qs("#tempVal").textContent = t.toFixed(1);
    qs("#mTokens").value = draft.maxTokens || 2048;
    qs("#swStream").classList.toggle("on", draft.stream);
    qs("#swStream").setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(!!draft.stream));
    qs("#mTest").hidden = true;
    qs("#advBox").hidden = true;
    qs("#advToggle").textContent = "展开 ›";
    qs("#advToggle").setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    var tc = API.ttsConfig ? (API.ttsConfig().data || {}) : {};
    qs("#ttsBase").value = tc.baseUrl || "https://api.mosi.cn/v1";
    qs("#ttsKey").value = "";
    qs("#ttsKey").placeholder = tc.hasKey ? "已保存（重新输入可覆盖）" : "留空则只用本机声线";
    qs("#ttsModel").value = tc.model || "moss-tts-1.5-flash";
    qs("#ttsState").textContent = tc.hasKey ? "已配置 · 云音色可用" : "未配置 · 仅本机声线";
    var pv = providerOf(MC);
    setPool(pv.models || [], "预设 " + pv.name + " 常用模型");
    qs("#mNameHint").textContent = "可直接敲字筛选，也可点「拉取列表」从该接口取回真实模型名。";
    paintChips();
    mask.style.display = "grid";
    qs("#mBase").focus();
  }
  function closeModel() { mask.style.display = "none"; closePool(); draft = null; }

  function readForm() {
    return {
      preset: draft ? draft.preset : "custom",
      baseUrl: qs("#mBase").value.trim(),
      key: qs("#mKey").value.trim(),
      model: qs("#mName").value.trim(),
      temp: qs("#tempRange").value / 10,
      maxTokens: Math.max(256, Math.min(32768, parseInt(qs("#mTokens").value, 10) || 2048)),
      stream: qs("#swStream").classList.contains("on")
    };
  }

  /* 落盘这一份配置并刷新卡片：测通与点「改用」都走它，卡片与表单不会各说一套。
     三项必填缺一律不写 —— 半成品配置落进去，别处读到的就是「已配置」的假象。 */
  async function saveTested(cfg) {
    if (!cfg.baseUrl || !cfg.key || !cfg.model) return null;
    await API.saveModelConfig(cfg);
    MC = (await API.fetchModelConfig()).data;
    if (draft) draft.model = cfg.model;
    renderModelCard();
    return MC;
  }

  async function testCfg(cfg, btn) {
    var box = qs("#mTest");
    box.hidden = false;
    box.className = "mtest";
    box.innerHTML = icon("loader-circle", 13) + "正在连通…";
    if (btn) btn.disabled = true;
    var r = await API.testModel(cfg);
    if (btn) btn.disabled = false;
    var d = r.data || {};
    if (d.ok) {
      /* 测通即存：以前测完还得再点一次「保存」，用户理解成「测好就算配好了」，
         关掉弹层才发现一项都没落盘（问题一的第 ③④ 条根因）。 */
      if (d.models && d.models.length) {
        setPool(d.models, "从接口拉取 · " + d.models.length + " 个");
        if (!qs("#mName").value.trim()) qs("#mName").value = d.models[0];
      }
      var final = readForm();
      var k = API.modelPresetKey(final.baseUrl);
      if (k) final.preset = k;
      await API.saveModelConfig(final);
      MC = (await API.fetchModelConfig()).data;
      /* 读回比对：setModelCfg 里 localStorage 写失败是会静静吞掉的（配额满 / 隐私模式），
         不比对就只能对着没落盘的配置说「已保存」—— 问题一第 ④ 条的另一半。 */
      var wrote = !!(MC && MC.baseUrl === final.baseUrl && MC.key === final.key && MC.model === final.model);
      draft = Object.assign(draft || {}, final);
      LAST_OK = wrote ? Date.now() : 0;
      paintChips();
      renderModelCard();
      var off = final.model && POOL.length && !inPool(final.model);
      if (wrote) {
        box.className = "mtest ok";
        box.innerHTML = icon("circle-check", 13) + "已保存 · " + esc(final.model) + " · 刚刚测通 · " +
          d.latency + 'ms<span class="mtest-note">' + esc(d.note || "") +
          (off ? " · 模型名不在拉回来的列表里，可在候选上方点「改用」" : "") + "</span>";
        qs("#mNameHint").textContent = "已保存到本机 · 改了地址或密钥再测一次即覆盖。";
      } else {
        box.className = "mtest err";
        box.innerHTML = icon("alert-triangle", 13) + "连通成功，但没能存进本机 · " + d.latency +
          'ms<span class="mtest-note">本机存储写不进去（配额已满或浏览器隐私模式）。清出空间或换普通窗口，' +
          '再点一次「测试连接」即会自动保存。</span>';
        qs("#mNameHint").textContent = "未保存 · 上面这条是存不进去，不是模型的问题。";
      }
    } else {
      /* 失败不落盘：半成品留在草稿里，下次打开还在，但不伪装成已配置 */
      box.className = "mtest err";
      box.innerHTML = icon("alert-triangle", 13) + esc(d.reason || "连通失败，请检查地址与密钥") +
        (KIND_HINT[d.kind] ? '<span class="mtest-note">' + esc(KIND_HINT[d.kind]) + "</span>" : "");
      qs("#mNameHint").textContent = "未保存 · 按上面这条改好再测。";
    }
    if (!qs("#mNamePop").hidden) renderPool();
  }

  /* 只拉列表、不兼职测连通：成功就把真实模型名交给候选面板，
     失败按 kind 给下一步 —— 拉不到列表和连不上是两件事。 */
  async function pullModels() {
    var btn = qs("#mPull");
    var hint = qs("#mNameHint");
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "拉取中…";
    var r = await API.fetchModels(readForm());
    btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "拉取列表";
    var d = r.data || {};
    if (d.ok && d.models.length) {
      setPool(d.models, "从接口拉取 · " + d.models.length + " 个");
      if (!qs("#mName").value.trim()) qs("#mName").value = d.models[0];
      openPool();
      var cur = qs("#mName").value.trim();
      hint.textContent = "已拉到 " + d.models.length + " 个真实模型名（" + d.latency + "ms）。" +
        (cur && !inPool(cur) ? "当前值不在列表里，已在候选上方标出。" : "");
    } else if (d.ok) {
      hint.textContent = "该接口不提供模型列表端点 · 手填模型名即可，「测试连接」会用一次最小对话验证连通。";
    } else {
      hint.textContent = (d.reason || "拉取失败") + (KIND_HINT[d.kind] ? " —— " + KIND_HINT[d.kind] : "");
    }
  }

  qs("#btnModel").addEventListener("click", openModel);
  qs("#mmEdit").addEventListener("click", openModel);
  qs("#modelX").addEventListener("click", closeModel);
  qs("#modelCancel").addEventListener("click", closeModel);
  mask.addEventListener("click", function (e) { if (e.target === mask) closeModel(); });
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Escape" && mask.style.display === "grid") closeModel(); });

  /* 候选面板交互：mousedown 拦默认 —— 点行不抢输入框焦点，面板才不会先被 blur 关掉。
     Esc 只收面板不收整窗（stopPropagation 挡住上面的整窗 Esc）。 */
  qs("#mName").addEventListener("input", function () {
    poolQ = this.value;
    poolSel = -1;
    if (qs("#mNamePop").hidden) openPool(); else renderPool();
  });
  /* 重新把光标放回输入框 = 重新看全部候选（上一次的筛选词作废） */
  qs("#mName").addEventListener("focus", function () { if (POOL.length) { poolQ = ""; openPool(); } });
  qs("#mName").addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown") { e.preventDefault(); moveSel(1); }
    else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") { e.preventDefault(); moveSel(-1); }
    else if (e.key === "Enter") {
      if (!qs("#mNamePop").hidden && poolSel >= 0 && poolRows[poolSel]) { e.preventDefault(); pickPool(poolRows[poolSel]); }
    } else if (e.key === "Escape") {
      if (!qs("#mNamePop").hidden) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); closePool(); }
    }
  });
  qs("#mNameList").addEventListener("mousedown", function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".ikp-item, .mdd-use")) e.preventDefault();
  });
  qs("#mNameList").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var use = e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".mdd-use");
    if (use && use.dataset.m) { pickPool(use.dataset.m); return; }
    var it = e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".ikp-item");
    if (it && it.dataset.m) pickPool(it.dataset.m);
  });
  /* 地址一改就认服务商：敲字过程中只更新高亮与候选（force=false 不动输入框），
     失焦时再把地址规范成标准写法 —— 一边打字一边改写用户的输入框是另一回事。 */
  qs("#mBase").addEventListener("input", function () { syncProvider(false); });
  qs("#mBase").addEventListener("change", function () { syncProvider(true); });
  document.addEventListener("mousedown", function (e) {
    if (qs("#mNamePop").hidden || !e.target.closest) return;
    if (!e.target.closest("#mNamePop, #mName, #mPull")) closePool();
  });
  window.addEventListener("resize", function () { if (!qs("#mNamePop").hidden) placePool(); });

  qs("#mKeyEye").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var inp = qs("#mKey");
    var show = inp.type === "password";
    inp.type = show ? "text" : "password";
    qs("#mKeyEye").innerHTML = icon(show ? "x" : "eye", 14);
  });
  qs("#advToggle").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var box = qs("#advBox");
    box.hidden = !box.hidden;
    qs("#advToggle").textContent = box.hidden ? "展开 ›" : "收起 ⌄";
    qs("#advToggle").setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!box.hidden));
  });
  qs("#tempRange").addEventListener("input", function (e) { qs("#tempVal").textContent = (e.target.value / 10).toFixed(1); });
  qs("#swStream").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var b = qs("#swStream");
    b.classList.toggle("on");
    b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(b.classList.contains("on")));
  });

  qs("#mTestBtn").addEventListener("click", function () { testCfg(readForm(), qs("#mTestBtn")); });
  /* 拉列表只拉列表：它不该顺带做一次「连通测试」，更不该在服务商没有 /models 时
     把一次 ping 的结论当成模型列表（问题一的头一条根因就是两个按钮同走一条路）。 */
  qs("#mPull").addEventListener("click", function () { pullModels(); });
  qs("#mmTest").addEventListener("click", async function () {
    var b = qs("#mmTest");
    b.disabled = true; b.textContent = "测试中…";
    var r = await API.testModel(MC);
    b.disabled = false; b.textContent = "测试连接";
    var d = r.data || {};
    if (d.ok) {
      LAST_OK = Date.now();
      renderModelCard();
      toast("连通正常 · " + d.latency + "ms · " + (d.models && d.models.length ? "可用模型 " + d.models.length + " 个" : "已记为刚刚测通"), "zap");
    } else {
      toast((d.reason || "连通失败") + (KIND_HINT[d.kind] ? " —— " + KIND_HINT[d.kind] : ""), "alert-triangle");
    }
  });

  qs("#ttsPull").addEventListener("click", async function () {
    var base = qs("#ttsBase").value.trim() || "https://api.mosi.cn/v1";
    var key = qs("#ttsKey").value.trim();
    var model = qs("#ttsModel").value.trim() || "moss-tts-1.5-flash";
    if (!key && !(API.ttsConfig().data || {}).hasKey) { toast("请先填写 Moss API Key", "alert-triangle"); return; }
    API.saveTtsConfig({ baseUrl: base, key: key, model: model });
    var btn = qs("#ttsPull");
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "拉取中…";
    var r = await API.mossVoices();
    btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "拉取音色";
    if (r.code === 0) {
      qs("#ttsState").textContent = "已配置 · 云音色 " + r.data.count + " 款";
      toast("已拉取 " + r.data.count + " 款云音色 · 去「主题商城 · 音色」查看", "audio-lines");
    } else {
      qs("#ttsState").textContent = "拉取失败";
      toast(r.msg || "拉取失败", "alert-triangle");
    }
  });

  qs("#modelOk").addEventListener("click", async function () {
    var cfg = readForm();
    var ttsBase = qs("#ttsBase").value.trim() || "https://api.mosi.cn/v1";
    var ttsKey = qs("#ttsKey").value.trim();
    var ttsModel = qs("#ttsModel").value.trim() || "moss-tts-1.5-flash";
    var hasLLM = !!(cfg.baseUrl && cfg.key && cfg.model);
    var hasTTS = !!ttsKey || !!(API.ttsConfig().data || {}).hasKey;
    if (!hasLLM && !hasTTS) {
      if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(cfg.baseUrl)) { toast("接口地址需以 http:// 或 https:// 开头", "alert-triangle"); return; }
      if (!cfg.key) { toast("请先填写 API Key", "alert-triangle"); return; }
      if (!cfg.model) { toast("请填写模型名称", "alert-triangle"); return; }
    }
    if (hasLLM) {
      if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(cfg.baseUrl)) { toast("接口地址需以 http:// 或 https:// 开头", "alert-triangle"); return; }
      await API.saveModelConfig(cfg);
      MC = (await API.fetchModelConfig()).data;
      renderModelCard();
    }
    var tts = { baseUrl: ttsBase, model: ttsModel };
    if (ttsKey) tts.key = ttsKey;
    API.saveTtsConfig(tts);
    closeModel();
    InkFX.flash();
    toast(hasLLM ? "模型已保存 · " + cfg.model : "云音色配置已保存", "cpu");
  });

  /* ============ 同步（演示）============
   原型没有云端：数据本机即时落盘，这里如实说明，不假装双端传输。 */
  /* v2.3：设备卡与同步日志改为真实数据 ——
     日志读 InkSync 的真实记录（inkread.synclog.v1，跨端同步）；
     「手机端」状态由日志里最近的非本机条目推断（真的有人从那端推过才算数）。 */
  function relTime(ts) {
    var s = Math.max(0, Math.round((Date.now() - ts) / 1000));
    if (s < 60) return s + " 秒前";
    if (s < 3600) return Math.round(s / 60) + " 分钟前";
    if (s < 86400) return Math.round(s / 3600) + " 小时前";
    return Math.round(s / 86400) + " 天前";
  }
  function renderSync() {
    var log = (window.InkSync && InkSync.log()) || [];
    /* 覆盖/保留逐项账：拉了不等于盖了 —— 用户要看的是「哪几颗被对端盖掉、哪几颗是本机这份赢」。
       零差异不写「覆盖 0 项」：那行没有信息量，只把日志挤长。 */
    function ledger(s) {
      var n = s.over || 0, k = s.keep || 0;
      if (!n && !k) return "";
      var head = "", body = "";
      if (n) { head += " · 覆盖 " + n + " 项"; body += "<div>覆盖：" + esc((s.overNames || []).join("、")) + "</div>"; }
      if (k) { head += " · 保留 " + k + " 项"; body += "<div>保留：" + esc((s.keepNames || []).join("、")) + "</div>"; }
      return head + "<details><summary>看明细</summary>" + body + "</details>";
    }
    qs("#syncLog").innerHTML = log.length
      ? log.slice(0, 6).map(function (s) {
          var what = s.action === "pull" ? "拉取 " + (s.pulled || 0) + " 项"
            : s.action === "sync" ? "双向 · 拉 " + (s.pulled || 0) + " / 推 " + (s.pushed || 0) + " 项"
            : s.action === "oversize" ? (s.keys || 0) + " 类数据过大 · 未参与同步" +
              ((s.names || []).length ? "（" + s.names.join("、") + "）" : "")
            : s.action === "prompts-redact" ? "提示词拦下 " + (s.dropped || 0) + " 枚 · 模板里有密钥样式的文本，这一枚没有上行"
            : "推送 " + (s.pushed || 0) + " 项";
          return "<li><b>" + esc(s.atText || "") + "</b>" + esc(s.device || "桌面") + " · " + esc(what) + ledger(s) + "</li>";
        }).join("")
      : '<li><span class="card-note">还没有同步过 —— 点「立即同步」，或从手机访问电脑 IP:8765 接入</span></li>';
    /* 超限键常驻提醒：这些键被留在本机、另一端看不到 —— 只写进日志一次不够看。 */
    var big = (window.InkSync && InkSync.oversize) ? InkSync.oversize() : [];
    var warn = qs("#syncWarn");
    warn.hidden = !big.length;
    if (big.length) {
      warn.innerHTML = icon("alert-triangle", 13) + "<span>此数据集过大，未参与同步：" +
        esc(big.map(function (b) { return b.label + " " + b.size; }).join("、")) +
        " · 单键上限 3 MB，其余数据照常同步</span>";
    }
    /* 桌面端 = 本窗口；手机端 = 日志里最近一条其他设备 */
    qs("#deskState").innerHTML = icon("circle-check", 13) + "本窗口";
    var other = log.filter(function (s) { return (s.device || "桌面") !== (window.InkSync ? InkSync.device() : "桌面"); })[0];
    qs("#phoneState").innerHTML = other
      ? icon("circle-check", 13) + esc(other.device || "远端") + " · " + relTime(other.at)
      : icon("clock", 13) + "尚无远端接入";
    var mems = memAll().filter(function (m) { return m.on !== false; }).length;
    var last = log[0];
    qs("#aiSub").textContent = "主脑已通读 " + ((window.shelfList ? shelfList() : DB.shelf) || []).length +
      " 份文档 · 学到 " + mems + " 条记忆 · " +
      (last ? "上次同步 " + relTime(last.at) : "尚未同步");
  }

  /* v2.3 真同步：与书架页同一引擎（拉取 + 推送本地服务快照） */
  qs("#btnSync").addEventListener("click", async function () {
    var b = qs("#btnSync");
    b.disabled = true;
    qs("#icSync").innerHTML = icon("loader-circle", 16);
    var r = await InkSync.now();
    qs("#icSync").innerHTML = icon("refresh-cw", 16);
    b.disabled = false;
    renderSync();
    InkFX.flash();
    if (r.offline) { toast("同步服务不可达 · 本机数据仍即时保存", "wifi-off"); return; }
    /* 服务端拒收（413 过大 / 500 落盘失败）不等于同步成功：变更留在队列里，下次重试 */
    if (r.failed) { toast("同步服务拒收本次数据（HTTP " + r.status + "）· 变更已保留，稍后自动重试", "alert-triangle"); return; }
    var extra = (r.oversize && r.oversize.length) ? " · " + r.oversize.length + " 类数据过大未参与同步" : "";
    var led = (r.over && r.over.length ? " · 覆盖 " + r.over.length + " 项" : "") +
      (r.keep && r.keep.length ? " · 保留 " + r.keep.length + " 项" : "");
    if (r.pulled > 0) {
      toast("已从另一端同步 " + r.pulled + " 项" + led + " · 即将刷新", "refresh-cw");
      setTimeout(function () { location.reload(); }, 900);
    } else {
      toast((r.pushed > 0 ? "已推送本机变更 " + r.pushed + " 项" : "两端已一致 · 无需同步") + led + extra,
        r.oversize && r.oversize.length ? "alert-triangle" : "circle-check");
    }
  });

  /* ============ 手机预览 ============ */
  function mTask(t) {
    var on = done(t.id);
    return '<div class="m-task' + (on ? " done" : "") + '" data-mt="' + t.id + '">' +
      '<div class="mt-body"><div class="mt-time">' + esc(t.time) + "</div>" +
      '<div class="mt-title">' + esc(t.title) + "</div></div>" +
      '<button class="m-check" aria-pressed="' + (on ? "true" : "false") + '" aria-label="' +
        esc((on ? "取消完成：" : "标记完成：") + t.title) + '">' + icon("check", 16) + "</button></div>";
  }
  /* 统计行：数值留给 InkStats 回调上漆（引擎异步校正时能刷新） */
  function mStat(label, id) {
    return '<div class="m-task"><div class="mt-body"><div class="mt-time">' + esc(label) +
      '</div><div class="mt-title" id="' + id + '">—</div></div></div>';
  }

  function renderPhone() {
    var dn = daily.filter(function (t) { return done(t.id); }).length;
    qs("#phSub").textContent = "已完成 " + dn + "/" + daily.length + " · 与桌面端同步";
    qs("#relayChip").innerHTML = icon("refresh-cw", 13) + "桌面端 → 手机端 · 实时镜像";
    if (state.ptab === "today") {
      qs("#phTitle").textContent = "今日清单";
      qs("#phBody").innerHTML = daily.map(mTask).join("");
    } else if (state.ptab === "plan") {
      qs("#phTitle").textContent = "计划原文";
      qs("#phBody").innerHTML = '<div class="phone-doc">' +
        '<h4>四、每日例行任务</h4>' +
        blocks_p() + "</div>";
    } else {
      qs("#phTitle").textContent = "我的";
      /* 数字取自本机统计引擎（inkread.stats.v1），和桌面端同一口径 ——
         原来这里是 mock 里的常量，手机预览上永远显示「21 天 / 46 分钟」。 */
      qs("#phBody").innerHTML =
        mStat("连续打卡", "msStreak") + mStat("今日阅读", "msToday") + mStat("本周字数", "msWeek");
      var setStat = function (id, txt) { var el = qs("#" + id); if (el) el.textContent = txt; };
      setStat("msStreak", InkStats.streakSmart() + " 天");
      InkStats.streakSmart(function (n) { setStat("msStreak", n + " 天"); });
      setStat("msToday", InkStats.fmtSec(InkStats.range("day").sec).join(" "));
      InkStats.range("day", function (r) { setStat("msToday", InkStats.fmtSec(r.sec).join(" ")); });
      setStat("msWeek", InkStats.fmtWords(InkStats.range("week").words).join(" "));
      InkStats.range("week", function (r) { setStat("msWeek", InkStats.fmtWords(r.words).join(" ")); });
    }
    qsa(".ptab").forEach(function (t) { t.classList.toggle("active", t.dataset.ptab === state.ptab); });
  }

  function blocks_p() {
    var c = DB.demoPlan || [];
    var li = c.filter(function (b) { return b.type === "list" && b.items && b.items.length && b.items[0].id && b.items[0].id.indexOf("d-t") === 0; })[0];
    return li ? "<p>" + li.items.map(function (i) { return esc(i.x); }).join("</p><p>") + "</p>" : "";
  }

  qs("#phBody").addEventListener("click", async function (e) {
    var c = e.target.closest(".m-check");
    if (!c) return;
    var row = c.closest(".m-task"), id = row.dataset.mt;
    if (done(id)) { await API.undoCheckin(id); }
    else { await API.checkin(id); }
    ck = InkStore.getCheckins();
    InkFX.ripple(c);
    renderPhone();
    var tip = qs("#mSyncTip");
    tip.classList.add("show");
    setTimeout(function () { tip.classList.remove("show"); }, 1600);
    toast(done(id) ? "手机端已打卡 · 同步至桌面端" : "手机端已撤销打卡", "smartphone");
  });

  qsa(".ptab").forEach(function (t) {
    t.addEventListener("click", function () { state.ptab = t.dataset.ptab; renderPhone(); InkFX.ripple(t); });
  });

  function clock() {
    var d = new Date();
    qs("#phTime").textContent = String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, "0") + ":" + String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0");
  }

  /* ============ 术语表：内置（只读）+ 自建（可增删） ============
     与 api.js 的 inkread.glossary.v1 同源；翻译时全量下发给模型，
     同名以用户为准 —— 读者改过的译名不该被内置表盖回去。 */
  var GL = { builtin: [], user: [] };
  function glQuery() { return (qs("#glSearch").value || "").trim().toLowerCase(); }
  function glMatch(t, q) {
    return !q || t.src.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0 || String(t.dst || "").toLowerCase().indexOf(q) >= 0;
  }
  function renderGloss() {
    var box = qs("#glList");
    if (!box) return;
    var q = glQuery();
    qs("#glSub").textContent = "内置 " + GL.builtin.length + " · 自建 " + GL.user.length;
    var rows = GL.builtin.filter(function (t) { return glMatch(t, q); }).map(function (t) { return glossRow(t, false); })
      .concat(GL.user.filter(function (t) { return glMatch(t, q); }).map(function (t) { return glossRow(t, true); }));
    box.innerHTML = rows.length ? rows.join("")
      : '<div class="card-note">' + (q ? "没有匹配「" + esc(q) + "」的术语。" : "还没有术语。添加后，翻译时会强制沿用。") + "</div>";
    qsa("[data-gl-del]", box).forEach(function (b) {
      b.addEventListener("click", async function () {
        var next = GL.user.filter(function (t) { return t.src !== b.dataset.glDel; });
        var r = await API.saveGlossary(next);
        GL.user = r.data || next;
        renderGloss();
        toast("已从术语表移除", "trash-2");
      });
    });
  }
  function glossRow(t, mine) {
    return '<div class="gl-row">' +
      '<span class="gl-src">' + esc(t.src) + '</span>' +
      '<span class="gl-dst">' + esc(t.dst) + '</span>' +
      (t.pos ? '<span class="gl-pos">' + esc(t.pos) + '</span>' : "") +
      (mine
        ? '<button class="gl-del" data-gl-del="' + esc(t.src) + '" aria-label="删除">' + icon("x", 13) + '</button>'
        : '<span class="gl-del void" aria-hidden="true"></span>') +
    '</div>';
  }
  qs("#glAdd").addEventListener("click", async function () {
    var src = qs("#glSrc").value.trim(), dst = qs("#glDst").value.trim();
    if (!src || !dst) { toast("原词与译名都要填", "info"); return; }
    var next = GL.user.filter(function (t) { return t.src !== src; });
    next.push({ src: src, dst: dst, pos: "" });
    var r = await API.saveGlossary(next);
    GL.user = r.data || next;
    qs("#glSrc").value = ""; qs("#glDst").value = "";
    renderGloss();
    toast("已加入术语表 · " + src, "languages");
  });

  /* ============ 术语表 · 导入 / 导出 / 检索 ============
     调研（DeepL 术语表导入 / Anki CSV 导入）：粘贴或选文件 → 自动认分隔符 →
     跳过表头 → 预览解析结果 → 重名按「跳过 / 覆盖」裁定 → 一次落库。
     解析走 API.parseGlossary（纯函数，不打网络），落库走 API.importGlossary。 */
  var IMP = { open: false, rows: [] };

  function impOpen(on) {
    IMP.open = on;
    var box = qs("#glImp");
    if (box) box.hidden = !on;
    qs("#glImportBtn").setAttribute("aria-expanded", on ? "true" : "false");
    if (on) impRefresh();
  }
  function impPolicy() {
    var r = qsa('input[name="glDup"]').filter(function (x) { return x.checked; })[0];
    return r ? r.value : "skip";
  }
  function impReset() {
    qs("#glPaste").value = "";
    qs("#glFileNote").textContent = "未选择";
    qs("#glFile").value = "";
    IMP.rows = [];
  }
  function impRefresh() {
    var text = qs("#glPaste").value;
    var pv = qs("#glPv"), doBtn = qs("#glDo");
    if (!text.trim()) {
      IMP.rows = [];
      pv.textContent = "还没有内容 —— 粘贴两列文本，或选一个 CSV / TSV 文件。";
      doBtn.textContent = "导入";
      doBtn.disabled = true;
      return;
    }
    var r = API.parseGlossary(text, { delim: qs("#glDelim").value, header: qs("#glHeader").checked });
    IMP.rows = r.rows;
    doBtn.disabled = !r.rows.length;
    /* 术语卡上有两个「导入」：开面板的和提交点的。同名会让读者以为点了两次同一件事。
       提交钮报出当次条数（这个数预览行本来就算好了），入口钮保持「导入」不动。 */
    doBtn.textContent = r.rows.length ? "导入 " + r.rows.length + " 条" : "导入";
    var bits = ["识别到 <b>" + r.rows.length + "</b> 条"];
    if (r.delimName) bits.push("分隔符 <b>" + esc(r.delimName) + "</b>");
    if (r.skippedHeader) bits.push("已跳过表头");
    if (r.bad) bits.push("<b>" + r.bad + "</b> 行读不出");
    if (!r.rows.length) bits.push("至少要两列：原词、译名");
    pv.innerHTML = bits.join(" · ");
  }

  qs("#glImportBtn").addEventListener("click", function () { impOpen(!IMP.open); });
  qs("#glCancel").addEventListener("click", function () { impOpen(false); });
  qs("#glSearch").addEventListener("input", renderGloss);
  qs("#glPaste").addEventListener("input", impRefresh);
  qs("#glDelim").addEventListener("change", impRefresh);
  qs("#glHeader").addEventListener("change", impRefresh);

  qs("#glFile").addEventListener("change", function () {
    var f = this.files && this.files[0];
    qs("#glFileNote").textContent = f ? f.name : "未选择";
    if (!f) { impRefresh(); return; }
    var fr = new FileReader();
    fr.onload = function () { qs("#glPaste").value = String(fr.result || ""); impRefresh(); };
    fr.onerror = function () { toast("文件读取失败，可改为直接粘贴", "info"); };
    fr.readAsText(f, "utf-8");
  });

  qs("#glDo").addEventListener("click", async function () {
    if (!IMP.rows.length) return;
    var r = await API.importGlossary(IMP.rows, impPolicy());
    var d = r.data || {};
    GL.user = d.user || GL.user;
    impReset();
    impOpen(false);
    qs("#glSearch").value = "";
    renderGloss();
    var msg = "导入完成 · 新增 " + (d.added || 0);
    if (d.over) msg += " · 覆盖 " + d.over;
    if (d.skip) msg += " · 跳过 " + d.skip;
    toast(msg, "languages");
  });

  qs("#glExport").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var seen = {}, list = [];
    GL.user.forEach(function (t) { seen[t.src] = 1; list.push(t); });
    GL.builtin.forEach(function (t) { if (!seen[t.src]) list.push(t); });
    var csv = list.map(function (t) { return [t.src, t.dst, t.pos || ""].join(","); }).join("\n");
    var blob = new Blob(["\ufeff" + "src,dst,pos\n" + csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8" });
    var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    var a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url; a.download = "inkread-glossary.csv";
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
    setTimeout(function () { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }, 1000);
    toast("已导出术语表 · " + list.length + " 条", "download");
  });

  /* ============ 提示词（v1.1-S5c · M2 注册表） ============
     表体在 api.js 内置，这一节只做「看 / 改 / 收回内置」三件事。
     覆盖只存改过的那几枚（api.js 的 Prompt.save 负责剔除与内置相同的部分），
     所以没动过的功能跟着版本一起升级，不会被这张表冻在旧文案上。 */
  var PM = { list: [], key: "" };
  function pmFind(k) {
    for (var i = 0; i < PM.list.length; i++) if (PM.list[i].k === k) return PM.list[i];
    return null;
  }
  function pmEdited(d) { return !!d.overridden || (d.edited || []).length > 0; }
  function pmRenderList() {
    var byG = {}, order = [];
    PM.list.forEach(function (d) {
      if (!byG[d.g]) { byG[d.g] = []; order.push(d.g); }
      byG[d.g].push(d);
    });
    qs("#pmList").innerHTML = order.map(function (g) {
      return '<div class="pm-g">' + esc(g) + "</div>" + byG[g].map(function (d) {
        return '<button type="button" class="pm-item' + (d.k === PM.key ? " on" : "") + '"' +
          (d.k === PM.key ? ' aria-current="true"' : "") + ' data-k="' + esc(d.k) + '">' +
          '<span class="pm-n">' + esc(d.n) + "</span>" +
          (pmEdited(d) ? '<span class="pm-dot" aria-label="这一枚改过"></span>' : "") + "</button>";
      }).join("");
    }).join("");
    var n = PM.list.filter(pmEdited).length;
    qs("#pmSub").textContent = PM.list.length + " 枚功能" + (n ? " · 已改 " + n + " 枚" : " · 全部照内置");
  }
  function pmRenderEdit() {
    var d = pmFind(PM.key), box = qs("#pmEdit");
    if (!d) { box.hidden = true; return; }
    box.hidden = false;
    qs("#pmName").textContent = d.n;
    qs("#pmKey").textContent = d.k;
    var tag = qs("#pmTag");
    tag.hidden = !pmEdited(d);
    tag.textContent = d.overridden ? "已改模板" : "已改参数";
    qs("#pmText").value = d.t;
    var ph = Object.keys(d.ph || {});
    qs("#pmPh").innerHTML = ph.length
      ? ph.map(function (p) { return "<li><code>{{" + esc(p) + "}}</code> — " + esc(d.ph[p]) + "</li>"; }).join("")
      : "<li>这一枚没有占位符，模板原样发给模型。</li>";
    /* 参数框：改过才回填，留空 = 不覆盖。占位文字写清内置值，让人知道不动它会发生什么。 */
    pmParamFill("pmTemp", d, "temp");
    pmParamFill("pmMax", d, "maxTokens");
    pmParamFill("pmTmo", d, "timeout", "秒");
    var mm = qs("#pmModel");
    mm.value = d.model || "";
    mm.placeholder = d.globalModel ? "跟随全局：" + d.globalModel : "跟随全局模型";
    pmMsg("");
  }
  function pmParamFill(id, d, f, unit) {
    var el = qs("#" + id), on = (d.edited || []).indexOf(f) >= 0;
    el.value = on ? String(f === "timeout" ? Math.round(d[f] / 1000) : d[f]) : "";
    var b = d.bp[f];
    if (b == null) { el.placeholder = "跟随全局"; return; }
    el.placeholder = (f === "timeout" ? Math.round(b / 1000) : b) + (unit ? " " + unit : "") + "（内置）";
  }
  function pmMsg(text, bad) {
    var el = qs("#pmMsg");
    el.textContent = text || "";
    el.classList.toggle("bad", !!bad);
  }
  function pmNum(id) {
    var v = qs("#" + id).value;
    return String(v).trim() === "" ? null : Number(v);
  }
  function pmOpen(k) {
    PM.key = k;
    pmRenderList();
    pmRenderEdit();
  }
  qs("#pmList").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest(".pm-item");
    if (b && b.dataset.k) pmOpen(b.dataset.k);
  });
  qs("#pmSave").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var d = pmFind(PM.key);
    if (!d) return;
    var tmo = pmNum("pmTmo");
    var r = API.promptSave(PM.key, {
      text: qs("#pmText").value,
      temp: pmNum("pmTemp"), maxTokens: pmNum("pmMax"),
      timeout: tmo == null ? null : Math.round(tmo * 1000),
      model: qs("#pmModel").value
    });
    if (r.code) { pmMsg(r.msg || "没有保存", true); toast(r.msg || "提示词没有保存", "alert-triangle"); return; }
    PM.list = API.promptList();
    pmRenderList(); pmRenderEdit();
    pmMsg("已保存 · 重载页面与另一台设备都会用这份");
    toast("已保存「" + d.n + "」的提示词", "check");
  });
  qs("#pmReset").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var d = pmFind(PM.key);
    if (!d) return;
    var r = API.promptReset(PM.key);
    if (r.code) { pmMsg(r.msg || "没有恢复", true); return; }
    PM.list = API.promptList();
    pmRenderList(); pmRenderEdit();
    toast(r.cleared ? "「" + d.n + "」已恢复内置" : "「" + d.n + "」本来就是内置", "rotate-ccw");
  });
  PM.list = API.promptList();
  if (PM.list.length) pmOpen(PM.list[0].k);

  /* ============ 启动 ============ */
  var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  state.ctxDoc = params.get("doc") || "";
  if (window.Brain) Brain.setDoc(state.ctxDoc || null);
  renderCtx();
  renderChatSub();
  renderMemory();
  pushMsg("ai", greet(), null, null);
  renderSync(); renderPhone(); clock();
  API.fetchModelConfig().then(function (r) { MC = r.data; renderModelCard(); renderChatSub(); });
  API.fetchGlossary().then(function (r) {
    GL.builtin = (r.data && r.data.builtin) || [];
    GL.user = (r.data && r.data.user) || [];
    renderGloss();
  });
  /* 记忆是学出来的，且学习发生在 DOMContentLoaded（晚于本段解析期渲染）。
     所以头部的「N 条记忆」不能只渲一次 —— 订阅主脑，学到新的就即时回流。
     只在真的变动时刷新，不做定时轮询（省电、不发烫）。 */
  if (window.Brain && Brain.onChange) {
    Brain.onChange(function () { renderSync(); renderMemory(); });
  }
  setInterval(clock, 30000);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

/* ============================================================
   api.js · API 桩层（形状即未来真实 API，接入时仅替换实现）
   ============================================================ */

(function () {
  var delay = function (ms) { return new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, ms); }); };
  var nowHM = function () {
    var d = new Date();
    return String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, "0") + ":" + String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0");
  };

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------
     称呼（本机档案）：单机应用没有账号，但界面确实需要知道「怎么称呼你」。
     原先各处硬填演示人设「林知夏」，切来切去没有任何作用 —— 改成一个可改的
     本机称呼：默认「读者」，在「本机数据」面板里改一次，七页与主脑问候同步。
     键 inkread.profile.v1 走通用导出/恢复（一切以 inkread. 开头的键都算本机数据）。
     ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  var K_PROFILE = "inkread.profile.v1";
  var DEFAULT_NAME = "读者";
  window.InkProfile = {
    name: function () {
      try {
        var v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K_PROFILE) || "null");
        var n = v && String(v.name || "").trim();
        return n ? n.slice(0, 12) : DEFAULT_NAME;
      } catch (e) { return DEFAULT_NAME; }
    },
    /* 头像取称呼首字；「读者」这类通用称呼用「读」，用户自定义则用其首字 */
    initial: function () { return String(window.InkProfile.name()).slice(0, 1); },
    isDefault: function () { return window.InkProfile.name() === DEFAULT_NAME; },
    set: function (raw) {
      var n = String(raw == null ? "" : raw).trim().slice(0, 12);
      var rec = { name: n, updatedAt: Date.now() };
      try {
        if (n && n !== DEFAULT_NAME) localStorage.setItem(K_PROFILE, JSON.stringify(rec));
        else localStorage.removeItem(K_PROFILE);      /* 改回默认 = 不留键，备份更干净 */
      } catch (e) {
        window.InkLog && InkLog.add("store", "称呼没能存进本机", "在「本机数据」里删掉几本已读完的书或旧封面，再改一次");
        return null;
      }
      return n || DEFAULT_NAME;
    }
  };

/* INK_SCHEMA —— 键级版本轨（v1.1-S6 G5）。只覆盖 localStorage 键；

  "inkread.tapHint.v1": { ver: 1, kind: "ui", store: "local", sync: true },
