  content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: -3px; right: -3px;
}
#mdSplit .md-grip:hover::before,
#mdSplit .md-grip.drag::before { background: var(--accent); top: 0; bottom: 0; }
body.md-col-drag { cursor: col-resize; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }

/* 仅预览（普通态）：单栏，隐藏 grip —— 兼容 #btnPreview 原逻辑 */
#mdSplit.preview-only { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
#mdSplit.preview-only .md-grip { display: none; }

/* ---------- B. 沉浸态：未开预览 → 单栏窄列跟 --nw-measure；开预览 → 双栏 + grip 可拖 ---------- */
body.nw .ol-wrap { max-width: var(--nw-measure, 680px); }
body.nw .md-split:not(.preview-only) textarea { max-width: var(--nw-measure, 680px); }
body.nw #mdSplit:not(.preview-only) { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
body.nw #mdSplit:not(.preview-only) .md-grip { display: none; }
/* 沉浸 + 预览：不再强制单栏，编辑/预览双栏各占拖拽后的轨道 */
body.nw #mdSplit.preview-only {
  grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, var(--md-a, 1fr)) 6px minmax(220px, var(--md-b, 1fr));
}
body.nw #mdSplit.preview-only textarea { display: block; max-width: none; margin: 0; }
body.nw #mdSplit.preview-only .md-preview { display: block; max-width: none; margin: 0; }
body.nw #mdSplit.preview-only .md-grip { display: block; }  /* 沉浸双栏时 grip 恢复可拖（压过上面普通态仅预览的隐藏） */

/* ---------- 沉浸浮条：栏宽滑杆（沿用全站设置抽屉的滑杆画法） ---------- */
.nw-measure { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-6); color: var(--ink-3); }
#nwWidth {
  -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; width: 96px; height: 22px;
  background: transparent; cursor: pointer; margin: 0;
}
#nwWidth::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 2px; background: var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius-2); }
#nwWidth::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none; width: 13px; height: 13px; margin-top: -5.5px; border: none;
  border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink-2);
}
#nwWidth::-moz-range-track { height: 2px; background: var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius-2); }
#nwWidth::-moz-range-thumb { width: 13px; height: 13px; border: none; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink-2); }
#nwWidth:focus-visible::-webkit-slider-thumb { background: var(--accent); }
.nw-wval { font-size: var(--fs-11); min-width: 26px; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: .04em; }

/* ---------- 窄屏：单栏、隐藏 grip；浮条里滑杆让位，避免挤爆 ---------- */
@media (max-width: 860px) {
  #mdSplit,
  body.nw #mdSplit.preview-only { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  #mdSplit .md-grip,
  body.nw #mdSplit.preview-only .md-grip { display: none; }
  /* 手机沉浸 + 预览：沉浸态页面不滚动，双栏堆叠会被裁切，回退为仅预览单栏 */
  body.nw #mdSplit.preview-only textarea { display: none; }
  body.nw .ol-wrap,
  body.nw #mdSplit textarea { max-width: none; }   /* 手机保持满宽，滑杆值让位 */
  #nwWidth { width: 72px; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .nw-measure { display: none; }
}

/* ============================================================
   笔记页增强 v15：幕布式大纲（折叠徽标 · 拖拽指示线）· 大纲⇄脑图一键切换 · Typora 式 MD
   ============================================================ */

/* ---------- 幕布大纲：折叠行的「+N」子级数徽标（灰字，点击展开） ---------- */
.ol-foldn {
  flex: none; margin: var(--space-3) var(--space-2) 0 0; padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-7);
  border: 1px dashed var(--rule); border-radius: var(--radius-999); background: none;
  cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink-3); font-size: var(--fs-10_5); letter-spacing: .04em;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.4; transition: .18s;
}
.ol-foldn:hover { border-style: solid; border-color: var(--accent-ink); color: var(--accent-ink); }

/* ---------- 幕布大纲：拖拽增强 —— 拖动行半透明；目标插入位画 3px 指示线 ----------
   .drop-line = 落到该行上方；.drop-line.drop-end = 落到列表末尾（线画在该行下方） */
#olList.dragging .ol-row.dragging { opacity: .45; }
.ol-row.drop-line::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; left: 2px; right: 2px; top: -3px; height: 3px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-3); background: var(--accent); pointer-events: none; z-index: 2;
}
.ol-row.drop-line.drop-end::before { top: auto; bottom: -3px; }

/* ---------- MD 专注模式（v2.10 · 真·跟随光标） ----------
   参考物是本机 Typora 的**真实实现**（C:\Program Files\Typora\resources\style\
   base-control.css，on-focus-mode 规则组）：
     .on-focus-mode .md-end-block:not(.md-focus):not(.md-focus-container) * { color: var(--blur-text-color) }
     .on-focus-mode .md-focus, .on-focus-mode .md-focus-container { color: var(--text-color) }
   即「当前块正常 · 其余块灰化 · 随光标移动」——旧实现是「固定区域渐隐 + 预览静态降灰」，
   跟「专注」这件事没关系（用户原话「莫名其妙」），本轮按真身重做，并如实分工：
     ① 编辑器（textarea，浏览器不允许按段着色）：给「光标所在段落」铺一条高亮带
        （覆盖层、不碰文本；位置由镜像测量得出，换行折行都算得准），其余文字**不降灰**；
     ② 预览区（真实 DOM）：与光标段落对应的块保持原色，其余降灰 .28，hover 可临时点亮；
     ③ 大纲：命中的节点高亮。三者都随光标实时更新，Esc 可退出。 */
body.md-focus .md-preview > * { opacity: .28; transition: opacity .22s; }
body.md-focus .md-preview > *.mdf-on { opacity: 1; }
body.md-focus .md-preview > *:hover { opacity: .92; }
html[data-reduce="on"] body.md-focus .md-preview > * { transition: none; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { body.md-focus .md-preview > * { transition: none; } }

body.md-focus #olList > * { opacity: .5; transition: opacity .22s; }
body.md-focus #olList > *.mdf-on { opacity: 1; }
html[data-reduce="on"] body.md-focus #olList > * { transition: none; }

/* 光标段落高亮带：绝对定位在编辑纸之上；左缘一道朱砂细线（只标"你在这一段"，不做重装饰） */
.md-split { position: relative; }
#mdFocusBand {
  position: absolute; z-index: 3; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-3);
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 8%, transparent);
  border-left: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) 52%, transparent);
  transition: top .12s ease, height .12s ease, opacity .16s ease;
}
body.md-focus #mdFocusBand { opacity: 1; }
html[data-reduce="on"] #mdFocusBand { transition: none; }
/* 镜像测量器：与 #mdEditor 同字体同盒模型，用来算「第 N 个字符落在第几行」（不可见、不占位） */
#mdMirror { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; z-index: -1; white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }

/* ============================================================
   v2.5 · 嵌入模式（阅读页「完整笔记」悬浮窗的 iframe 宿主）
   契约（与 reader 侧约定，勿改）：
     · URL：notes.html?embed=1&doc=<docId>&note=<noteId 可选>
     · 点嵌入条 ✕ → window.parent.postMessage({ type: "inkread:embed-close" }, "*")
   状态类：html.embed —— <head> 内联脚本最早加上（首帧即嵌窗布局，不闪外壳）；
          body.embed —— 页尾脚本加上的正式状态 + 挂 26px 嵌入条。
   两处挂载点对样式等价；与沉浸态 body.nw 会打架的规则只用 body.embed 作用域（见 ·nw 组）。
   非嵌入模式一条规则都不命中 → 原样不回归。
   ============================================================ */

/* ---------- 1. 藏外壳：开场 / 顶栏（app.js 注入）/ 侧导航 / 页头 ---------- */
html.embed .boot, body.embed .boot,
html.embed .device-topbar, body.embed .device-topbar,
html.embed .app-nav, body.embed .app-nav,
html.embed .page-head, body.embed .page-head { display: none !important; }

/* ---------- 2. 外壳铺满 iframe 视口：边距 / 圆角 / 最大宽度清零 ----------
   .device 同时关掉入页动画（appIn 有 0.46s 延迟）：嵌窗要即时可用 */
html.embed .device, body.embed .device {
  height: 100vh; height: 100dvh; min-height: 0; max-width: none;
  margin: 0; padding: 0; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; animation: none;
}
html.embed .screen, body.embed .screen {
  height: auto; min-height: 0; max-width: none;
  margin: 0; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none;
}
/* 顶部让出 26px 嵌入条；.app-content 的 overflow-y:auto 保持不动（内容区自己滚） */
html.embed .app-content, body.embed .app-content { padding: var(--space-26) 0 0; }
/* 页内边距收紧铺满；沉浸态自带 0 边距规则，故用 :not(.nw) 让位 */
body.embed:not(.nw) .page { max-width: none; margin: 0; padding: var(--space-12) var(--space-14) var(--space-20); }
/* v2.11 Bug1：嵌窗高度全由 iframe 视口定 —— 上界换成嵌窗口径，且写在 .work-layout 上，
   让左右两卡共用同一个预算（v2.18：只改右卡会让左列表按全页口径越界）。 */
html.embed .work-layout, body.embed .work-layout { --work-h-max: calc(100dvh - 26px - 32px); }
html.embed .work-card, body.embed .work-card { min-height: 0; }

/* ---------- 3. 工作台：左栏收窄 240px（压过 1180px 断点的单栏回退） ---------- */
html.embed .work-layout, body.embed .work-layout { grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr; }
/* 页头藏了，给三视图页签条（.view-bar）补一条顶部安全间距 */
body.embed:not(.nw) .view-bar { padding-top: var(--space-6); }
/* 沉浸态在嵌窗里照旧单栏铺满：nw 规则在前，这里用更高优先级压回 */
body.embed.nw .work-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0; height: 100%; }

/* 窄浮窗（<820px）：左栏整体让位，只留编辑器 */
@media (max-width: 819.98px) {
  html.embed .work-layout, body.embed .work-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  html.embed .work-layout > .card:first-child,
  body.embed .work-layout > .card:first-child { display: none; }
}

/* ---------- 4. 嵌入条：26px 细条（fixed 顶），纸色 + 底边线 ----------
   z-index 200 < 沉浸浮条 260：沉浸态里由 nw-bar 盖住（藏外壳的一致语义），
   .app-content 的 26px 让位在沉浸态同样成立，不会裁切内容 */
.embed-bar {
  position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; z-index: 200; height: 26px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-10); padding: 0 var(--space-6) 0 var(--space-12);
  background: var(--paper); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-size: var(--fs-11_5); letter-spacing: .06em; color: var(--ink-3);
}
.embed-bar .eb-title { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.embed-bar .eb-title b { font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--ink-2); }
.embed-bar .eb-x {
  margin-left: auto; flex: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: none; border: none; border-radius: var(--r-xs); color: var(--ink-3);
  cursor: pointer; transition: color .18s, background .18s;
}
.embed-bar .eb-x:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper-3); }
.embed-bar .eb-x:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -1px; }

/* ============================================================
   v2.17 · 嵌窗重排（用户实测反馈：批注浮窗里「完整笔记」要穿过八层横条才到内容）
   —— 只作用于 body.embed（阅读页浮窗里的那一份），全页 notes.html 一条都不命中。
   —— 原则：一页签一职责；重复的层整条撤；控件不许折行、不许溢出浮窗。
   —— 调研依据：Readwise / Zotero / Notion 在窄面板里一律压平为一层页签，
      没有任何产品既给「三视图页签」又额外挂一个「切换到导图」大按钮（见 v2.17 方案 §一）。
   ============================================================ */

/* 1. 嵌入条整条撤：书名浮窗外已经写着，它的 ✕ 与浮窗自己的 ✕ 是同一件事 */
body.embed .embed-bar { display: none !important; }
html.embed .app-content, body.embed .app-content { padding: 0; }
body.embed:not(.nw) .page { padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-10) var(--space-10); }
html.embed .work-layout, body.embed .work-layout { --work-h-max: calc(100dvh - 18px); }
html.embed .work-card, body.embed .work-card { min-height: 0; }

/* 1b. 撑满浮窗高度。原状：编辑卡按自身内容高结束，浮窗下半截是一整片死白
      （走查证据 shots-layout/05、probe-embed-340）。
      .npane / .ol-wrap / .md-split 早就写了 flex:1 + min-height:0，缺的是从
      .app-content 到 .work-card 这一路的「高度」——补齐四段即可，不动任何内部规则。 */
body.embed .app-content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
body.embed .page { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
body.embed .work-layout { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; align-items: stretch; }
body.embed .work-card { height: 100%; }

/* 2. 标题行压到一行：沉浸钮在浮窗里与浮窗自身的「最大化」重复，撤下 */
body.embed .wb-head { padding: var(--space-7) var(--space-10); gap: var(--space-8); flex-wrap: nowrap; }
body.embed .wb-head .wb-imm { display: none; }
body.embed .wb-head .field { min-width: 120px; }

/* 3. 三视图页签单行不折（去图标、收内距）；「导图视图」按钮与同步标语一并撤下 */
body.embed .view-bar { padding: 0 var(--space-10); gap: var(--space-8); flex-wrap: nowrap; }
body.embed .view-bar .ntype-tabs { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }
body.embed .ntype-tab { white-space: nowrap; padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-9); font-size: var(--fs-12); gap: 0; }
body.embed .ntype-tab .ic { display: none; }
body.embed #btnViewSwap, body.embed .view-sync { display: none; }
/* 「同一份笔记 · 三视图实时同步」：三视图同源是这套编辑器的实现事实
   （同一棵笔记树的三种渲染），不必每屏占一行广告位；全页一并撤下。 */
#viewSync { display: none; }

/* 4. 工具条：单行铺满、禁横滚（v2.23 W6.2 收口）。
      原先折两行占高度，改成「单行 + overflow-x:auto」—— 但横滚会把看不见的钮变成
      「不存在的钮」，还会在暗主题里留一条浅色滚条（正是问题六.2 指的那处）。
      实测（probe-w6-embed，360/300/480 三档嵌窗）钮数 9、scrollWidth 恒等于 clientWidth，
      也就是说横滚这条今天已经用不上：改成 wrap 不改变任何现有画面，只把这条
      「以后加钮就复发」的路堵掉。行内提示照旧撤（与下方教学框是同一句话）。 */
body.embed .md-toolbar { flex-wrap: wrap; padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-10); gap: var(--space-3); }
body.embed .md-toolbar .card-note, body.embed .md-toolbar .spacer { display: none; }
body.embed .md-toolbar .tool-btn { flex: none; }

/* 5. 常驻教学框撤（全页保留）；列表内距收紧 */
body.embed .ol-hint { display: none; }
body.embed .ol-wrap { padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-10) var(--space-12); }

/* 6. 底部动作条贴底、单行、不溢出；「回到原文」在浮窗里就在原文旁边，撤
   —— v2.23 W6.2 续：这条原先被 JS 那句 inline style 顶掉（内联优先于规则），
      「回到原文」实际一直在浮窗里占 61px，把两个钮挤到被切（实测 340 宽各切 9px）。
      改在 openNote() 里按 EMBED 决定是否渲染，规则留在这儿做兜底。
      钮一律 flex:none：.btn 带 overflow:hidden，flex 项一旦有它就没有 min-width:auto 兜底，
      会被压到比文案还窄 —— 与 .seg-btn 同一个病根。牺牲位只有提示语（它自带省略号）。 */
body.embed .wb-foot { padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-10); gap: var(--space-8); flex-wrap: nowrap; }
body.embed .wb-foot .btn { flex: none; }
body.embed .wb-foot .ef-hint { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
body.embed #gotoSrc { display: none; }

/* 7. 溢出根治：窄到 300px 也不许把内容顶出浮窗。左列（笔记列表）在浮窗里
      与「批注」页签同义，一律让位；编辑/预览在 640px 以下改上下叠 */
body.embed .page, body.embed .work-layout, body.embed .work-card,
body.embed .npane, body.embed .wb-head, body.embed .view-bar { min-width: 0; }
body.embed .work-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
body.embed .work-layout > .card:first-child { display: none; }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  body.embed .md-split { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  body.embed .md-split textarea { border-right: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-2); }
}

/* ============================================================
   v2.17 · 全页：左栏三组筛选分层（原来两条同款 segmented 叠在一起，
   分不清谁是谁）—— 第一组保持主控件规格，后两组降为轻量档并各自带一行小标。
   ============================================================ */
.flt-cap {
  display: block; margin: var(--space-2) 0 var(--space-5); font-size: var(--fs-10_5); letter-spacing: .14em;
  color: var(--ink-3);
}
.seg.seg-quiet { border: none; background: none; padding: 0; gap: var(--space-4); }
#colorDots { align-items: center; }
.dot-cap { font-size: var(--fs-10_5); letter-spacing: .14em; color: var(--ink-3); margin-right: var(--space-2); }
/* 「导图视图」按钮与「脑图」页签是同一个动作的两个入口 —— 全页同样撤下（id 与监听保留）。
   必须 !important：updateViewSwap() 每次切视图都写内联 style.display="inline-flex"，
   内联优先级高于本条，不加 important 等于没撤。 */
#btnViewSwap { display: none !important; }
/* 工具条那句「行首 ○ 切优先级 · 行尾加分类」与下方 .ol-hint 教学框重复，留信息更全的那一处 */
.md-toolbar .card-note { display: none; }

/* ============================================================
   v2.9.2 · 列表卡片对齐优化（用户实测反馈）
   —— 原问题：底部行「形态徽标 vs 文档名」在两个尺寸上打架：
      文档名窄容器折成两行、徽标随 flex center 悬浮在两行之间；
      另有些卡片预览行数不同造成底部行高低参差。
   —— 修法：文档名单行截断不参与折行；整行垂直居中即天然齐平；
      顶部行圆点/类型/时间用固定节奏对齐。 */
#notesList .note-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
#notesList .nr-top { align-items: center; }
#notesList .nr-top .nr-dot { flex: none; }
#notesList .nr-foot { gap: var(--space-8); }
#notesList .nr-ntype { flex: none; line-height: 1.45; }
#notesList .nr-doc {
  flex: 0 1 auto; min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis;
  font-size: var(--fs-11); letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--ink-3);
  text-align: right;
}
/* 预览区恒占两行高：一行预览的卡片与两行的卡片底缘一致，列表看着成行 */
#notesList .nr-prev { min-height: 2.2em; }
/* 标题与预览的节奏固定（不随字体档变化打架） */
#notesList .nr-title { margin-bottom: var(--space-4); }

/* 标题限 2 行：个别超长标题原本折 3 行把卡片撑高，列表高度参差的主因 */
#notesList .nr-title {
  display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* ============================================================
   v2.9.3 · 左右两栏底边对齐（用户实测反馈：右编辑器卡早早结束、
   左列表还在延伸，底部差一大截）。
   —— 根因：.work-layout 用 align-items:start，两卡各按自身内容高结束。
   —— 修法：stretch 让两卡等高，左卡内部改为 flex 列、列表区吃满余量并在卡内滚动。
   v2.18 补：只 stretch 不够 —— 左卡不受上界约束，而它的列表按 100vh 另算一个
   max-height（styles.css:1289）。笔记一长，「卡内其他横条 + 列表 650」就超过了
   右卡的上界，行高被左卡顶起来，右卡却仍被夹住，底边又差开了（实测 959 vs 670）。
   现在两卡共用同一条 --work-h-max，列表不再自己按视口算高，只吃卡里剩下的。 */
.work-layout { align-items: stretch; }
.work-layout > .card:first-child {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; max-height: var(--work-h-max);
}
/* v2.19.5 · 「切到笔记顿一下」的真正落点（探针 probe-leftcard.js 逐帧 rect）：
   —— 左卡 560 → 670 发生在 t=248ms，而 vtSheetDown 在 235ms 结束 —— 纸刚掀完，
      两卡（stretch 等高）一起往下长 110px。用户说的「卡片纵向由短变长」是对的；
      我先前用 ResizeObserver 量出「560 全程不变」是首帧取样偏晚，把这条漏了。
   —— 病根：卡高由内容决定。列表为空时卡内自然高不足 min-height 560，
      填上数据后自然高正好 = 预算 --work-h-max，于是「长到预算才停」。
      让左卡从第一帧就占满预算，行高不再随数据变。
   —— 只在双列布局钉：≤1180 是单列堆叠，列表另有 300px 上界（styles.css:1910），
      那里撑满预算会留出一大段空白。 */
@media (min-width: 1181px) {
  .work-layout > .card:first-child { min-height: var(--work-h-max); }
}
.work-layout > .card:first-child .notes-list {
  flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; max-height: none;
}
/* v2.19.2 · 卡内超高时筛选条整条消失（用户实测：「类型/形态」看不到字）
   —— flex 列的每个子项默认可收缩；而 .seg / .field 带 overflow:hidden，
      按规范其「自动最小尺寸」退化为 0，于是收缩按各子项基准高等比例分摊，
      筛选条被压到十几像素，12.5px 的文字被自身 overflow:hidden 整行裁光 —— 只剩色块与描边。
   —— 收缩只该落在列表上（它自己会滚），其余固定控件一律钉住。 */
.work-layout > .card:first-child > :not(.notes-list) { flex-shrink: 0; }
/* v2.19.5 · 同一条链上的 grow 也要收：.search-box 全局写的是 flex:1（styles.css:573），
   那是给书架横向工具条准备的；落到这张 flex 列卡里就变成纵向拉伸 —— 实测首帧搜索框
   被撑到 145.5px，数据到位后又掉回 40px。余量只该给列表。 */
.work-layout > .card:first-child > :not(.notes-list) { flex-grow: 0; }
/* 窗口极矮时（工作台上界小于固定控件之和）让整卡滚动，而不是把搜索框顶出卡框 */
.work-layout > .card:first-child { overflow: auto; }
/* 右卡在拉伸后编辑区自然增高（.work-card 已是 flex 列、min-height 560 保留） */

/* ============ v2.9.4 · 输入区与周边区分（用户实测反馈：都白成一片） ============
   编辑纸：比周边微亮 + 内描边 + 顶部轻内凹（明确"这是可输入区"）；
   预览纸：比纸色沉一档 + 同款内描边（两栏形成"两张纸"的对照）。
   深色主题下同样成立（paper→paper-3 的深浅关系不随主题反转）。 */
/* v2.10：改用全局纸面 token（styles.css :root 的 --sheet / --sheet-2 / --sheet-edge），
   与画板、脑图共用同一份「纸」—— 三处编辑面从此一个口径，不再各调各的色。
   分层靠「更纸」而不是「更白」：编辑纸比周边浅一档深，预览纸再深一档，纸纹走 --grain。 */
.md-split textarea {
  background-color: var(--sheet);
  background-image: var(--grain);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--sheet-edge), inset 0 2px 6px -4px var(--edge),
              0 1px 2px -1px var(--edge);
}
.md-split .md-preview {
  background-color: var(--sheet-2);
  background-image: var(--grain);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--sheet-edge);
}
/* 脑图画布：同一张纸 + 极淡点阵（读起来像方格纸，节点是"画上去的东西"） */
body[data-page="notes"] .mm-stage {
  background-color: var(--sheet);
  background-image: var(--grain), radial-gradient(circle, var(--sheet-rule) .7px, transparent .7px);
  background-size: auto, 18px 18px;
  background-position: 0 0, 9px 9px;
}
</style>
<script src="ink-keys.js"></script>
<script src="fonts.js"></script>
<script src="theme.js"></script>
</head>
<body data-page="notes">
  <a class="skip-link" href="#appContent">跳到主内容</a>
<div class="boot" id="boot" aria-hidden="true">
  <span class="boot-seal">墨</span>
  <span class="boot-name">墨读 InkRead</span>
  <span class="boot-line"></span>
</div>
<div class="device">
  <div class="screen" id="screen">
    <main class="app-content" id="appContent" tabindex="-1">
      <div class="page">
        <div class="page-head">
          <div class="ph-main">
            <h1 class="page-title">笔记</h1>
            <span class="ph-sub" id="notesSub"></span>
          </div>
          <div class="ph-actions">
            <button class="btn btn-ghost" id="btnExport" title="导出当前筛选与搜索结果（Markdown / CSV / 可还原 JSON）"><span id="icExport"></span>导出批注</button>
            <button class="btn btn-mark" id="btnNew"><span id="icNew"></span>新建笔记</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="rule-2line" aria-hidden="true"></div>

        <div class="work-layout">
          <!-- 左：筛选 + 列表 -->
          <div class="card card-pad">
            <span class="flt-cap">类型</span>
            <div class="seg mb-12" id="kindSeg">
              <button class="seg-btn on" data-kind="all">全部</button>
              <button class="seg-btn" data-kind="highlight">高亮</button>
              <button class="seg-btn" data-kind="note">笔记</button>
              <button class="seg-btn" data-kind="bookmark">书签</button>
            </div>
            <span class="flt-cap">形态</span>
            <div class="seg seg-quiet mb-12" id="ntypeSeg">
              <button class="seg-btn on" data-ntype="all">全部视图</button>
              <button class="seg-btn" data-ntype="outline">大纲</button>
              <button class="seg-btn" data-ntype="mindmap">脑图</button>
              <button class="seg-btn" data-ntype="md">MD</button>
            </div>
            <div class="row mb-12" style="gap:8px">
              <span class="dot-cap">颜色</span>
              <span class="theme-dots" id="colorDots">
                <span class="theme-dot on" data-color="all" style="background:var(--ink-3)"></span>
                <span class="theme-dot" data-color="accent" style="background:var(--accent)"></span>
                <span class="theme-dot" data-color="green" style="background:var(--green)"></span>
                <span class="theme-dot" data-color="amber" style="background:var(--amber)"></span>
                <span class="theme-dot" data-color="blue" style="background:var(--blue)"></span>
              </span>
              <span class="spacer"></span>
              <span class="card-note" id="listCount" aria-live="polite"></span>
            </div>
            <select class="field mb-12" id="docFilter" aria-label="按来源文档筛选"></select>
            <div class="search-box note-search mb-12">
              <span id="icNSearch"></span>
              <input class="field" id="noteSearch" type="search" placeholder="搜索笔记…" aria-label="搜索笔记" title="可搜标题、正文、脑图与文档名">
            </div>
            <div class="notes-list" id="notesList" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="笔记列表"></div>
          </div>

          <!-- 右：同一份笔记 · 三视图工作台 -->
          <div class="card work-card">
            <div class="wb-head">
              <input class="field" id="titleInput" placeholder="笔记标题（可选）" aria-label="笔记标题">
              <span class="wb-src" id="srcChip" style="display:none"></span>
              <button class="tool-btn wb-imm" id="btnImm" title="沉浸写作（F）" aria-label="进入沉浸写作模式"><span id="icImm"></span></button>
            </div>

            <div class="view-bar">
              <div class="ntype-tabs" id="viewTabs" role="tablist" aria-label="笔记视图">
                <button class="ntype-tab active" data-view="outline" role="tab" aria-selected="true"><span id="tabIcOutline"></span>大纲</button>
                <button class="ntype-tab" data-view="mindmap" role="tab" aria-selected="false"><span id="tabIcMind"></span>脑图</button>
                <button class="ntype-tab" data-view="md" role="tab" aria-selected="false"><span id="tabIcMd"></span>Markdown · LaTeX</button>
              </div>
              <button class="tool-btn wide" id="btnViewSwap" title="一键切换到思维导图"><span id="icViewSwap"></span><span id="btnViewSwapLabel">导图视图</span></button>
              <span class="view-sync" id="viewSync"><span id="icSyncView"></span>同一份笔记 · 三视图实时同步</span>
            </div>

            <!-- 一、文字大纲（含递进 / 优先级 / 分类） -->
            <div class="npane on" data-view="outline">
              <div class="md-toolbar">
                <button class="tool-btn" id="olIndent" title="缩进一级（Tab）" aria-label="缩进一级"><span id="icIndent"></span></button>
                <button class="tool-btn" id="olOutdent" title="反缩进（Shift+Tab）" aria-label="取消缩进"><span id="icOutdent"></span></button>
                <span class="sep"></span>
                <button class="tool-btn" id="olUp" title="上移" aria-label="上移"><span id="icUp"></span></button>
                <button class="tool-btn" id="olDown" title="下移" aria-label="下移"><span id="icDown"></span></button>
                <span class="sep"></span>
                <button class="tool-btn" id="olAdd" title="新增同级条目" aria-label="新增同级条目"><span id="icOlAdd"></span></button>
                <span class="spacer"></span>
                <span class="card-note">行首 ○ 切优先级 · 行尾加分类</span>
              </div>
              <div class="ol-wrap">
                <div class="ol-hint">
                  <span id="olHintIc"></span>
                  <!-- .ol-hint 是 flex 容器：裸文本节点会被拆成独立 item 挤成竖条，须整体包一层 -->
                  <span>分点写作：<kbd>Enter</kbd> 起新条目，<kbd>Tab</kbd> 降为子级，<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> 升回上级；行首标记切换优先级，行尾加分类标签。</span>
                </div>
                <div id="olList"></div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 二、思维导图（同一棵树的图形视图） -->
            <div class="npane" data-view="mindmap">
              <div class="mm-stage" id="mmStage">
                <svg class="mm-svg" id="mmSvg"></svg>
                <div class="mm-tools">
                  <input class="field" id="mmEdit" placeholder="选中节点后改文字" style="width:168px">
                  <button class="tool-btn" id="mmAdd" title="添加子节点" aria-label="添加子节点"><span id="icMmAdd"></span></button>
                  <button class="tool-btn" id="mmDel" title="删除节点" aria-label="删除节点"><span id="icMmDel"></span></button>
                  <button class="tool-btn" id="mmOrder" title="按脑图布局重排大纲" aria-label="按脑图重排大纲"><span id="icMmOrder"></span></button>
                </div>
                <div class="mm-hint">拖节点移动 · 拖空白平移 · 滚轮缩放 · 双击空白新建 · 位置为视图信息，不写入正文</div>
                <div class="mm-zoom">
                  <button class="tool-btn" id="mmZoomOut" title="缩小" aria-label="缩小"><span id="icZoomOut"></span></button>
                  <span class="mm-zval" id="mmZoomVal">100%</span>
                  <button class="tool-btn" id="mmZoomIn" title="放大" aria-label="放大"><span id="icZoomIn"></span></button>
                  <button class="tool-btn" id="mmFit" title="适应画布" aria-label="适应画布"><span id="icFit"></span></button>
                </div>
                <div class="mm-empty" id="mmEmpty">还没有条目<br>双击空白处新建，或先在大纲视图分点，再回到这里</div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <!-- 三、Markdown · LaTeX（树的实时序列化） -->
            <div class="npane" data-view="md">
              <div class="md-toolbar">
                <button class="tool-btn" data-md="**" title="加粗" aria-label="加粗"><span id="icBold"></span></button>
                <button class="tool-btn" data-md="*" title="斜体" aria-label="斜体"><span id="icItalic"></span></button>
                <button class="tool-btn" data-md="## " title="标题" aria-label="标题"><span id="icH"></span></button>
                <span class="sep"></span>
                <button class="tool-btn" data-md="- " title="无序列表" aria-label="无序列表"><span id="icList"></span></button>
                <button class="tool-btn" data-md="1. " title="有序列表" aria-label="有序列表"><span id="icOlist"></span></button>
                <button class="tool-btn" data-md="> " title="引用" aria-label="引用"><span id="icQuote"></span></button>
                <span class="sep"></span>
                <button class="tool-btn" data-md="`" title="行内代码" aria-label="行内代码"><span id="icCode"></span></button>
                <button class="tool-btn" data-md="$$" title="公式块" aria-label="公式块"><span id="icSigma"></span></button>
                <button class="tool-btn" data-md="[文字](链接)" title="链接" aria-label="链接"><span id="icLink"></span></button>
                <button class="tool-btn" data-md="table" title="表格" aria-label="表格"><span id="icTable"></span></button>
                <span class="spacer"></span>
                <button class="tool-btn" id="btnMdFocus" title="专注模式" aria-label="专注模式" aria-pressed="false"><span id="icMdFocus"></span></button>
                <button class="tool-btn" id="btnPreview" title="切换预览" aria-label="切换预览"><span id="icEye"></span></button>
              </div>
              <div class="md-split" id="mdSplit">
                <textarea id="mdEditor" aria-label="笔记正文" spellcheck="false" placeholder="Markdown 是笔记树的实时序列化，改这里会同步回大纲与脑图。&#10;&#10;## 一级要点&#10;- 子条目（缩进 2 空格降一级）&#10;&#10;行内公式 $C_{total}=\alpha\bar{t}+\beta r+\gamma L$&#10;&#10;$$ r = \frac{n_{regress}}{n_{lines}} \times 100\% $$"></textarea>
                <div class="md-grip" id="mdGrip" title="拖拽调整宽度 · 双击复位" aria-label="调整编辑区与预览宽度" role="separator" aria-orientation="vertical"></div>
                <div class="md-preview" id="preview"></div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="wb-foot">
              <button class="btn btn-accent btn-sm" id="btnSave"><span id="icSave"></span><span id="btnSaveLabel">保存</span></button>
              <button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" id="btnDel" disabled><span id="icDel"></span>删除</button>
              <span class="spacer"></span>
              <a class="nc-goto" id="gotoSrc" style="display:none" href="#"></a>
              <span class="ef-hint" id="editorHint">未命名笔记</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- 沉浸写作浮条：只在沉浸态出现，3.2s 无操作自动收起，任意移动/点击唤回 -->
<div class="nw-bar hide" id="nwBar" aria-hidden="true" role="toolbar" aria-label="沉浸写作工具条">
  <div class="nw-tabs" id="nwTabs" role="tablist" aria-label="笔记视图">
    <button class="nw-tab active" data-view="outline" role="tab" aria-selected="true">大纲</button>
    <button class="nw-tab" data-view="mindmap" role="tab" aria-selected="false">脑图</button>
    <button class="nw-tab" data-view="md" role="tab" aria-selected="false">Markdown</button>
  </div>
  <span class="nw-sep"></span>
  <span class="nw-meta" id="nwMeta"></span>
  <span class="nw-measure" id="nwMeasureBox" title="栏宽（540 – 1180px）">
    <span id="icNwWidth"></span>
    <input type="range" id="nwWidth" min="540" max="1180" step="20" value="680" aria-label="正文栏宽">
    <span class="nw-wval" id="nwWidthVal">680</span>
  </span>
  <span class="spacer"></span>
  <span class="nw-dirty" id="nwDirty" data-dirty="off">已保存</span>
  <button class="tool-btn" id="nwSave" title="保存（Ctrl+S）" aria-label="保存笔记"><span id="icNwSave"></span></button>
  <button class="tool-btn" id="nwExit" title="退出沉浸（Esc）" aria-label="退出沉浸写作"><span id="icNwExit"></span></button>
</div>

<div class="toast-root" id="toastRoot" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false"></div>
<script src="mock.js"></script>
<script src="md.js"></script>
<script src="api.js"></script>
<script src="app.js"></script>
<script src="brain.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);

  /* ============================================================
     嵌入模式（v2.5 · 阅读页「完整笔记」悬浮窗的 iframe 宿主）
     契约：notes.html?embed=1&doc=<docId>&note=<noteId 可选>
     点嵌入条 ✕ → window.parent.postMessage({ type: "inkread:embed-close" }, "*")
     html.embed 已由 <head> 内联脚本加上（首帧即嵌窗布局）；
     这里补 body.embed 正式状态，并挂上 26px 嵌入条。
     doc= / note= 的落地在 boot() 里（过滤器 + 自动打开）。
     ============================================================ */
  var EMBED = params.get("embed") === "1";
  var embedDocId = EMBED ? (params.get("doc") || "") : "";
  var embedBook = null;   /* 该书在书架里的记录（查不到 → null，条上显示「全部笔记」） */
  if (EMBED) {
    document.body.classList.add("embed");
    var embedShelf = (window.shelfList ? shelfList() : DB.shelf) || [];
    embedBook = embedShelf.find(function (d) { return d.id === embedDocId; }) || null;
    var embedBar = document.createElement("div");
    embedBar.className = "embed-bar";
    embedBar.id = "embedBar";
    embedBar.setAttribute("role", "banner");
    embedBar.innerHTML =
      '<span class="eb-title">完整笔记 · <b class="eb-book">' +
        (embedBook ? "《" + esc(embedBook.title) + "》" : "全部笔记") +
      "</b></span>" +
      '<button class="eb-x" id="embedClose" type="button" title="关闭" aria-label="关闭完整笔记窗口">' +
        icon("x", 15) + "</button>";
    document.body.insertBefore(embedBar, document.body.firstChild);
    qs("#embedClose").addEventListener("click", function () {
      try { window.parent.postMessage({ type: "inkread:embed-close" }, "*"); } catch (e) {}
    });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     单一真相源：state.tree（扁平文档序的结构树）
     节点 = { id, lv, text, done, folded, pri, tag, md }
       lv   0–4 层级（Tab / Shift+Tab 调整，拖拽整块移动）
       pri  0–3 优先级（○ / ! / !! / !!!），行首标记循环切换
       tag  分类标签，行尾 chip
       md   挂在该条目下的非结构片段（公式块 / 代码块 / 表格），无损保留
     state.mind = 视图配置（节点坐标），由树派生，不写入正文
     state.tree ⇄ Markdown 由 serialize() / parse() 互转
     ============================================================ */
  var state = {
    notes: [], kind: "all", ntype: "all", color: "all", doc: "all", q: "",
    curId: null, view: "outline",
    tree: [], olFocus: 0, olSel: null,
    mind: null, mmSel: null, mmView: { x: 0, y: 0, k: 1 }, mmDrag: null,
    mdTimer: null, dirty: false, saving: false, editSeq: 0
  };

  var PRI_MARK = ["○", "!", "!!", "!!!"];
  var VSHORT = { outline: "大纲", mindmap: "脑图", md: "Markdown" };

  var IC = {
    icExport: "download", icNew: "plus", icNSearch: "search",
    tabIcOutline: "list-tree", tabIcMind: "network", tabIcMd: "sigma",
    icSyncView: "refresh-cw",
    icIndent: "indent-increase", icOutdent: "indent-decrease",
    icUp: "arrow-up", icDown: "arrow-down", icOlAdd: "plus",
    icMmAdd: "plus", icMmDel: "trash-2", icMmOrder: "list-tree",
    icZoomIn: "zoom-in", icZoomOut: "zoom-out", icFit: "focus",
    icBold: "bold", icItalic: "italic", icH: "heading", icList: "list", icOlist: "list-ordered",
    icQuote: "quote", icCode: "code", icSigma: "sigma", icLink: "link", icTable: "table",
    icEye: "eye", icMdFocus: "focus", icSave: "circle-check", icDel: "trash-2",
    icImm: "maximize-2", icNwSave: "circle-check", icNwExit: "minimize",
    icNwWidth: "move-horizontal"
  };
  Object.keys(IC).forEach(function (id) { var el = qs("#" + id); if (el) el.innerHTML = icon(IC[id], 16); });
  qs("#olHintIc").innerHTML = icon("info", 14);

  /* v2.19.5 · 页头副标题首帧落字。数据本身就在 localStorage 里，是 API.fetchNotes() 前置的
     delay(200) 让它 200ms 后才出现在页面上；而这段字要占几行取决于宽度（390px 下换到 4 行）。
     min-height:1lh 只兜得住一行，窄屏照样往下顶 —— 这里在首次绘制前就把文案写进去，
     首帧排版即最终排版，转场结束后不再有任何推移（renderList 稍后会用同一函数覆写，内容一致）。 */
  qs("#notesSub").textContent = subText(window.InkStore ? InkStore.getNotes() : []);

  var COLOR_HEX = { accent: "var(--accent)", green: "var(--green)", amber: "var(--amber)", blue: "var(--blue)", ink: "var(--ink-3)" };
  var KIND_LABEL = { highlight: "高亮", note: "笔记", bookmark: "书签", margin: "随笔" };
  /* 批注条目可能来自同步/导入，kind 缺失或不在四类里时不能把「undefined」印在行首 ——
     兜一个中性标签，筛选（state.kind）仍按原值走，不影响命中。 */
  function kindLabel(n) { return KIND_LABEL[n && n.kind] || "批注"; }
  var NTYPE_ICON = { outline: "list-tree", mindmap: "network", md: "sigma" };

  /* 文档名 / 筛选 / 归属与书架同源（含用户导入的文档，不再只看 mock 书架）。
     查不到时不许写「未知文档」——那等于告诉用户「坏了」却不说是哪一条：
     带上 docId 前 6 位，两条孤儿笔记才分得开，也才好对着回收站找。 */
  function noteShelf() { return (window.shelfList ? shelfList() : DB.shelf) || []; }
  function docTitle(id) {
    var d = noteShelf().find(function (x) { return x.id === id; });
    return d ? d.title : (id ? "未收录文档 · #" + String(id).slice(0, 6) : "未收录文档");
  }
  function curDocId() {
    var n = state.notes.find(function (x) { return x.id === state.curId; });
    if (n) return n.docId;
    var s = noteShelf();
    return state.doc !== "all" ? state.doc : (s[0] ? s[0].id : "");
  }
  function titleText() { return qs("#titleInput").value.trim() || "中心主题"; }
  function mindNode(id) {
    if (!state.mind) return null;
    return state.mind.nodes.find(function (n) { return n.id === id; }) || null;
  }

  qs("#docFilter").innerHTML = '<option value="all">全部文档</option>' + noteShelf().map(function (d) {
    return '<option value="' + d.id + '">' + esc(d.title) + "</option>";
  }).join("");

  /* ============================================================
     树的基本操作
     ============================================================ */
  function newNode(lv, text) {
    return { id: uid("o"), lv: lv | 0, text: text || "", done: false, folded: false, pri: 0, tag: "", md: "" };
  }
  function normRow(r) {
    return {
      id: r.id || uid("o"), lv: r.lv | 0, text: r.text || "",
      done: !!r.done, folded: !!r.folded, pri: r.pri | 0, tag: r.tag || "", md: r.md || ""
    };
  }
  /* 某行的子树结束位置（不含） */
  function blockEnd(i) {
    var lv = state.tree[i].lv, j = i + 1;
    while (j < state.tree.length && state.tree[j].lv > lv) j++;
    return j;
  }
  function isHidden(i) {
    var lv = state.tree[i].lv;
    for (var j = i - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
      if (state.tree[j].lv < lv) {
        if (state.tree[j].folded) return true;
        lv = state.tree[j].lv;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  /* 缩进 / 反缩进：整块（含全部后代）一起动，块内相对层级不变（幕布语义）。
     缩进限制：不超上一行 +1 级且不超 4 级；反缩进下限 0 级。成功返回 true。 */
  function indentRow(i) {
    var r = state.tree[i];
    if (!r) return false;
    var prev = state.tree[i - 1];
    if (!prev || prev.lv < r.lv || r.lv >= 4) return false;
    var end = blockEnd(i);
    for (var j = i; j < end; j++) state.tree[j].lv = Math.min(4, state.tree[j].lv + 1);
    return true;
  }
  function outdentRow(i) {
    var r = state.tree[i];
    if (!r || r.lv <= 0) return false;
    var end = blockEnd(i);
    for (var j = i; j < end; j++) state.tree[j].lv = Math.max(0, state.tree[j].lv - 1);
    return true;
  }

  /* ============================================================
     序列化 ⇄ 解析（树 ⇄ Markdown）
     serialize：lv0 → ## 标题；lv≥1 → 缩进 (lv-1)*2 的 - 条目
                行尾 ✔ 表完成，[!]/[!!]/[!!!] 表优先级，#标签 表分类
     parse    ：反向；无法归入树的内容挂到最近条目作为附注（无损）
     ============================================================ */
  function serialize(tree) {
    var out = [];
    tree.forEach(function (r) {
      var t = String(r.text || "").trim();
      if (!t) return;
      var pre = (r.pri | 0) > 0 ? "[" + new Array((r.pri | 0) + 1).join("!") + "] " : "";
      var suf = (r.done ? " ✔" : "") + (r.tag ? " #" + r.tag : "");
      if (r.lv <= 0) out.push("## " + pre + t + suf);
      else out.push(new Array(r.lv).join("  ") + "- " + pre + t + suf);
      if (r.md) {
        var ind = r.lv <= 0 ? "" : new Array(r.lv + 1).join("  ");
        String(r.md).split("\n").forEach(function (l) { out.push(ind + l); });
      }
    });
    return out.join("\n");
  }

  function parseInline(lv, s) {
    s = String(s);
    var pri = 0, done = false, tag = "";
    var m = s.match(/^\[(!{1,3})\]\s*/);
    if (m) { pri = m[1].length; s = s.slice(m[0].length); }
    var tm = s.match(/\s#([^\s#]+)\s*$/);
    if (tm) { tag = tm[1]; s = s.slice(0, tm.index); }
    if (/\s*✔\s*$/.test(s)) { done = true; s = s.replace(/\s*✔\s*$/, ""); }
    return normRow({ lv: lv, text: s.trim(), done: done, pri: pri, tag: tag });
  }

  function parse(md) {
    var lines = String(md || "").replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n").split("\n");
    var tree = [], last = null, i = 0;
    function attach(block) { if (last) last.md = (last.md ? last.md + "\n" : "") + block; }

    while (i < lines.length) {
      var raw = lines[i], t = raw.trim();
      if (!t) { i++; continue; }

      if (/^```/.test(t)) {
        var buf = [raw]; i++;
        while (i < lines.length && !/^```/.test(lines[i].trim())) { buf.push(lines[i]); i++; }
        if (i < lines.length) { buf.push(lines[i]); i++; }
        attach(buf.join("\n"));
        continue;
      }

      if (t === "$$" || /^\$\$/.test(t)) {
        var b2 = [raw], closed = t.length > 2 && /\$\$$/.test(t);
        i++;
        if (!closed) {
          while (i < lines.length && !/\$\$$/.test(lines[i])) { b2.push(lines[i]); i++; }
          if (i < lines.length) { b2.push(lines[i]); i++; }
        }
        attach(b2.join("\n"));
        continue;
      }

      var h = t.match(/^(#{1,6})\s+(.*)$/);
      if (h) {
        if (h[1].length === 1) { i++; continue; }   /* # 留给笔记标题 */
        var hn = parseInline(h[1].length - 2, h[2]);
        tree.push(hn); last = hn; i++;
        continue;
      }

      var li = raw.match(/^(\s*)([-*+]|\d+\.)\s+(.*)$/);
      if (li) {
        var indent = li[1].replace(/\t/g, "  ").length;
        var ln = parseInline(Math.floor(indent / 2) + 1, li[3]);
        tree.push(ln); last = ln; i++;
        continue;
      }

      /* 开头没有前序行可挂的普通文字：起一行（lv 0）而不是 attach 到 null。
         旧行为会把「第一个标题/列表之前」的文字整段蒸发 —— md 顶行手写的
         文字保存后从编辑器和正文里同时消失（闸 n-err 实测到的静默丢字）。 */
      if (!last) { last = parseInline(0, raw); tree.push(last); }
      else attach(raw);
      i++;
    }
    return tree;
  }

  /* ============================================================
     旧数据一次性迁移：无 outline 时由 mind / body / text 反推
     ============================================================ */
  function migrateNote(n) {
    if (n.outline && n.outline.length) return false;
    if (n.mind && n.mind.nodes && n.mind.nodes.length) {
      var kids = {};
      n.mind.nodes.forEach(function (x) { (kids[x.parent] = kids[x.parent] || []).push(x); });
      var rows = [];
      (function walk(id, lv) {
        (kids[id] || []).slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.y - b.y || a.x - b.x; }).forEach(function (c) {
          rows.push(normRow({ lv: Math.min(4, lv), text: c.text }));
          walk(c.id, lv + 1);
        });
      })(n.mind.root, 0);
      if (rows.length) { n.outline = rows; return true; }
    }
    if (n.body && String(n.body).trim()) {
      n.outline = parse(n.body);
      if (n.outline.length) return true;
    }
    if (n.text && String(n.text).trim()) {
      n.outline = [normRow({ lv: 0, text: n.text })];
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  /* ============================================================
     列表
     ============================================================ */
  /* v2.12 自由文本搜索：关键词 AND · "短语" · -取反（与闪卡页 Anki-lite 同习惯）。
     无字段操作符 —— 分类/类型/颜色/文档维度已有可见筛选控件承担。 */
  function parseQuery(q) {
    var terms = [], negs = [], re = /(-?)"([^"]*)"|(-?)(\S+)/g, m;
    while ((m = re.exec(q))) {
      var t = (m[2] !== undefined ? m[2] : m[4]).toLowerCase();
      if (!t) continue;
      if (m[1] || m[3]) negs.push(t); else terms.push(t);
    }
    return { terms: terms, negs: negs };
  }
  /* 可搜域：标题 / 摘录 / 大纲节点 / 脑图节点 / 正文(去格式) / 文档名 */
  function qParts(n) {
    var parts = [];
    if (n.title) parts.push(["标题", n.title]);
    if (n.text) parts.push(["摘录", n.text]);
    if (n.outline && n.outline.length) parts.push(["大纲", n.outline.map(function (r) { return r.text || ""; }).join("\n")]);
    if (n.mind && n.mind.nodes) parts.push(["脑图", n.mind.nodes.map(function (x) { return x.text || ""; }).join("\n")]);
    if (n.body) parts.push(["正文", MD.plain(n.body)]);
    parts.push(["文档", docTitle(n.docId)]);
    return parts;
  }
  function matchNote(n, query) {
    var parts = qParts(n), srcs = [], lows = [];
    for (var g = 0; g < query.negs.length; g++) {
      for (var j = 0; j < parts.length; j++)
        if (parts[j][1].toLowerCase().indexOf(query.negs[g]) !== -1) return { ok: false, srcs: [] };
    }
    if (!query.terms.length) return { ok: true, srcs: [] };
    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
      var low = parts[i][1].toLowerCase(), every = true;
      for (var t = 0; t < query.terms.length; t++)
        if (low.indexOf(query.terms[t]) === -1) { every = false; break; }
      lows.push(low);
      if (every) srcs.push(parts[i][0]);
    }
    /* AND 语义按整篇笔记计：词可分散在不同域（标题+正文分含一词也算命中） */
    var big = "\n" + lows.join("\n") + "\n";
    for (var t2 = 0; t2 < query.terms.length; t2++)
      if (big.indexOf(query.terms[t2]) === -1) return { ok: false, srcs: [] };
    return { ok: true, srcs: srcs };
  }
  /* 大小写不敏感切片高亮：所有词的命中区间合并后切 <mark>，其余原样 esc() */
  function markRanges(text, terms) {
    if (!text) return null;
    var low = text.toLowerCase(), ranges = [];
    terms.forEach(function (t) {
      if (!t) return;
      var i = 0;
      while ((i = low.indexOf(t, i)) !== -1) { ranges.push([i, i + t.length]); i += t.length; }
    });
    if (!ranges.length) return null;
    ranges.sort(function (a, b) { return a[0] - b[0]; });
    var merged = [ranges[0].slice()];
    for (var i = 1; i < ranges.length; i++) {
      var last = merged[merged.length - 1];
      if (ranges[i][0] <= last[1]) last[1] = Math.max(last[1], ranges[i][1]);
      else merged.push(ranges[i].slice());
    }
    var out = "", pos = 0;
    merged.forEach(function (r) {
      out += esc(text.slice(pos, r[0])) + "<mark>" + esc(text.slice(r[0], r[1])) + "</mark>";
      pos = r[1];
    });
    return out + esc(text.slice(pos));
  }

  function filtered() {
    var q = (state.q || "").trim();
    var query = q ? parseQuery(q) : null;
    return state.notes.filter(function (n) {
      if (state.kind !== "all" && n.kind !== state.kind) return false;
      if (state.ntype !== "all" && nType(n) !== state.ntype) return false;
      if (state.color !== "all" && n.color !== state.color) return false;
      if (state.doc !== "all" && n.docId !== state.doc) return false;
      if (query && !matchNote(n, query).ok) return false;
      return true;
    });
  }

  function noteTitle(n) {
    if (n.title) return n.title;
    if (nType(n) === "mindmap" && n.mind && n.mind.nodes) {
      var r = n.mind.nodes.find(function (x) { return x.id === n.mind.root; });
      if (r && r.text) return r.text;
    }
    if (n.outline && n.outline.length) {
      var f = n.outline.find(function (r) { return (r.text || "").trim(); });
      if (f) return f.text;
    }
    if (n.body) return MD.plain(n.body).slice(0, 30);
    return n.text ? n.text.slice(0, 30) : "书签";
  }
  function notePreview(n) {
    if (n.outline && n.outline.length) {
      return n.outline.map(function (r) { return (r.text || "").trim(); }).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 7).join(" · ");
    }
    if (n.mind && n.mind.nodes) return n.mind.nodes.map(function (x) { return x.text; }).slice(0, 9).join(" · ");
    if (n.body) return MD.plain(n.body).slice(0, 70);
    return n.text || "";
  }

  function subText(notes) {
    if (!notes.length) return "还没有批注 · 划选保存或新建后，都在这里统一管理";
    var docs = noteShelf().filter(function (d) { return notes.some(function (n) { return n.docId === d.id; }); }).length;
    return notes.length + " 条批注 · 覆盖 " + docs + " 份文档 · 一棵笔记树，大纲 / 脑图 / Markdown 三视图同源";
  }

  function renderList() {
    var q = (state.q || "").trim();
    var query = q ? parseQuery(q) : null;
    var list = filtered();
    qs("#listCount").textContent = query ? "命中 " + list.length + " / " + state.notes.length + " 条" : list.length + " 条";
    qs("#notesSub").textContent = subText(state.notes);
    if (!list.length) {
      /* v2.22 三态：一条都没有 ≠ 筛选没筛到 —— 前者给专属空态（「还没有笔记」+ 真实两条
         创建路径：阅读页划选 / 本页「新建笔记」），后者维持原「换个筛选条件」的说法。 */
      qs("#notesList").innerHTML = !state.notes.length
        ? '<div class="empty">' + icon("notebook-pen", 30) +
          "<p>还没有笔记<br>在阅读页划选文字，保存高亮或随笔；也可以直接新建一条大纲 / 脑图</p>" +
          '<button class="btn btn-primary" id="emptyNew" type="button">' + icon("plus", 15) + "新建笔记</button></div>"
        : query
        ? '<div class="empty">' + icon("search-x", 28) +
          "<p>未找到与「" + esc(q) + "」匹配的笔记<br>试试更短的关键词，或去掉引号与负号</p>" +
          '<button class="btn btn-ghost" id="btnClearSearch" type="button">清除搜索</button></div>'
        : '<div class="empty">' + icon("notebook-pen", 28) + "<p>没有符合条件的笔记<br>换个筛选条件试试</p></div>";
      var cb = qs("#btnClearSearch");
      if (cb) cb.addEventListener("click", clearSearch);
      var nb = qs("#emptyNew");
      if (nb) nb.addEventListener("click", newNote);
      return;
    }
    qs("#notesList").innerHTML = list.map(function (n) {
      var ttl = noteTitle(n) || "无标题";
      var ttlMark = query ? markRanges(ttl, query.terms) : null;
      var pv = notePreview(n) || "";
      /* v2.9.2：预览与标题重复（画线取原文当标题的常见情形）就不重复显示 —— 视觉噪音 */
      var dup = ttl && pv && (pv === ttl || ttl.indexOf(pv.slice(0, 16)) === 0 || pv.indexOf(ttl.slice(0, 16)) === 0);
      var pvMark = (!dup && query) ? markRanges(pv, query.terms) : null;
      /* 命中来源徽标：标题与预览里都看不到命中原文时，说明命中的是脑图/正文/文档名等域 */
      var hit = query ? matchNote(n, query) : null;
      var hitBadge = (hit && hit.srcs.length && !ttlMark && !pvMark)
        ? '<span class="nr-hit">命中 ' + esc(hit.srcs.join(" · ")) + "</span>" : "";
      return '<div class="note-row' + (n.id === state.curId ? " on" : "") + '" data-note="' + n.id + '">' +
        '<div class="nr-top"><span class="nr-dot" style="background:' + (COLOR_HEX[n.color] || COLOR_HEX.accent) + '"></span>' +
        kindLabel(n) + '<span class="spacer"></span>' + esc(n.at || "") + "</div>" +
        '<div class="nr-title">' + (ttlMark || esc(ttl)) + "</div>" +
        (dup ? "" : '<div class="nr-prev">' + (pvMark || esc(pv)) + "</div>") +
        '<div class="nr-top nr-foot" style="margin:8px 0 0"><span class="nr-ntype">' + icon(NTYPE_ICON[nType(n)], 11) + NTYPE_LABEL[nType(n)] + "</span>" +
        hitBadge +
        '<span class="spacer"></span><span class="nr-doc" title="' + esc(docTitle(n.docId)) + '">' + esc(docTitle(n.docId)) + "</span></div>" +
        "</div>";
    }).join("");
    qsa("#notesList .note-row").forEach(function (r) {
      r.addEventListener("click", function () { openNote(r.dataset.note); });
    });
  }

  /* ============================================================
     载入 / 视图切换
     ============================================================ */
  function openNote(id) {
    var n = state.notes.find(function (x) { return x.id === id; });
    if (!n) return;
    state.curId = id;
    qs("#titleInput").value = n.title || "";
    qs("#srcChip").style.display = "inline-flex";
    qs("#srcChip").innerHTML = icon("book-marked", 12) + '<span class="wb-src-t">' + esc(docTitle(n.docId)) + " · P" + (n.page || 1) + "</span>";
    qs("#gotoSrc").style.display = EMBED ? "none" : "inline-flex";
    qs("#gotoSrc").href = srcLink(n.docId, n.id);
    qs("#gotoSrc").innerHTML = icon("arrow-up-right", 12) + "回到原文";
    qs("#btnDel").disabled = false;

    if (migrateNote(n)) InkStore.upsertNote(n);

    state.tree = (n.outline || []).map(normRow);
    state.olFocus = 0; state.olSel = null;
    state.mind = n.mind ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(n.mind)) : null;
    state.mmSel = state.mind ? state.mind.root : null;
    qs("#mmEdit").value = state.mmSel ? (mindNode(state.mmSel) || {}).text || "" : "";

    var v = (n.ntype === "mindmap" || n.ntype === "md" || n.ntype === "outline") ? n.ntype : "outline";
    setView(v);
    renderList();
    setDirty(false);
  }

  function flushMd() {
    var ta = qs("#mdEditor");
    if (ta) state.tree = parse(ta.value);
  }

  function setView(v) {
    if (state.view === "md" && v !== "md") flushMd();
    state.view = v;
    qsa("#viewTabs .ntype-tab").forEach(function (t) {
      var on = t.dataset.view === v;
      t.classList.toggle("active", on);
      t.setAttribute("aria-selected", on ? "true" : "false");
    });
    qsa(".npane").forEach(function (p) { p.classList.toggle("on", p.dataset.view === v); });

    if (v === "outline") renderOutline();
    else if (v === "mindmap") {
      var relaid = syncMind();
      if (relaid) fitMind();
      renderMind();
    } else {
      qs("#mdEditor").value = serialize(state.tree);
      syncPreview();
    }
    updateViewSwap();
    updateHint();
  }

  /* 大纲 ⇄ 脑图 一键切换（幕布调研项）：只切当前视图，存储类型 ntype 不变 */
  function updateViewSwap() {
    var b = qs("#btnViewSwap"); if (!b) return;
    if (state.view === "md") { b.style.display = "none"; return; }
    b.style.display = "inline-flex";
    var toMind = state.view === "outline";
    b.title = toMind ? "一键切换到思维导图" : "返回大纲视图";
    b.setAttribute("aria-label", b.title);
    qs("#btnViewSwapLabel").textContent = toMind ? "导图视图" : "返回大纲";
    qs("#icViewSwap").innerHTML = icon(toMind ? "network" : "list-tree", 14);
  }
  qs("#btnViewSwap").addEventListener("click", function () {
    setView(state.view === "mindmap" ? "outline" : "mindmap");
  });

  qsa("#viewTabs .ntype-tab").forEach(function (t) {
    t.addEventListener("click", function () {
      if (t.dataset.view === state.view) return;
      setView(t.dataset.view);
      if (state.view === "outline" && !state.tree.length) {
        state.tree = [newNode(0, "")];
        renderOutline();
        setTimeout(function () { focusRow(0, false); }, 20);
      }
    });
  });

  function updateHint() {
    var t = qs("#titleInput").value.trim() || "未命名笔记";
    var n = state.tree.filter(function (r) { return (r.text || "").trim(); }).length;
    var hot = state.tree.filter(function (r) { return (r.pri | 0) >= 2; }).length;
    qs("#editorHint").textContent = t + " · 条目 " + n + (hot ? " · 高优先 " + hot : "") + " · 当前视图 " + VSHORT[state.view];
    immMeta(); immTabs();
  }
  qs("#titleInput").addEventListener("input", function () {
    updateHint();
    if (state.mind) { var r = mindNode(state.mind.root); if (r) { r.text = titleText(); renderMind(); } }
  });

  /* ============================================================
     一、文字大纲
     ============================================================ */
  function autoGrow(ta) { ta.style.height = "auto"; ta.style.height = Math.max(26, ta.scrollHeight) + "px"; }

  function renderOutline() {
    var wrap = qs("#olList");
    if (!state.tree.length) {
      wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="ol-empty">按工具栏「新增」起第一条，或用 Enter 连续分点</div>';
      return;
    }
    var html = "";
    for (var i = 0; i < state.tree.length; i++) {
      var r = state.tree[i];
      if (isHidden(i)) continue;
      var hasKids = (i + 1 < state.tree.length && state.tree[i + 1].lv > r.lv);
      var pri = r.pri | 0;
      var nHide = (hasKids && r.folded) ? blockEnd(i) - i - 1 : 0;   /* 折叠时被藏住的后代数 */
      html += '<div class="ol-row' + (r.done ? " done" : "") + (r.id === state.olSel ? " on" : "") + (pri >= 2 ? " hot" : "") +
        '" data-i="' + i + '" data-lv="' + r.lv + '" data-pri="' + pri + '">' +
        '<button class="ol-caret' + (hasKids ? "" : " leaf") + (r.folded ? " folded" : "") + '" data-act="fold" tabindex="-1" aria-label="折叠">' + icon("chevron-down", 13) + "</button>" +
        '<button class="ol-pri" data-act="pri" tabindex="-1" title="优先级：点击循环（○ / ! / !! / !!!）" aria-label="优先级">' + PRI_MARK[pri] + "</button>" +
        '<span class="ol-dot"></span>' +
        '<textarea class="ol-input" rows="1" data-i="' + i + '" placeholder="' + (r.lv === 0 ? "一级要点" : "子要点") + '">' + esc(r.text) + "</textarea>" +
        '<button class="ol-tag' + (r.tag ? " on" : "") + '" data-act="tag" tabindex="-1" title="分类标签" aria-label="分类标签">' +
        (r.tag ? "#" + esc(r.tag) : icon("tag", 12)) + "</button>" +
        (nHide ? '<button class="ol-foldn" data-act="fold" tabindex="-1" title="展开 ' + nHide + ' 条子级" aria-label="展开子级">+' + nHide + "</button>" : "") +
        '<button class="ol-check" data-act="check" tabindex="-1" aria-label="标记完成">' + icon("check", 11) + "</button>" +
        '<span class="ol-grip">' + icon("grip-vertical", 14) + "</span>" +
        "</div>";
    }
    wrap.innerHTML = html;
    qsa(".ol-input", wrap).forEach(autoGrow);
  }

  function focusRow(i, toEnd) {
    var ta = qs('.ol-input[data-i="' + i + '"]', qs("#olList"));
    if (!ta) return;
    ta.focus();
    var len = ta.value.length;
    ta.selectionStart = ta.selectionEnd = toEnd === false ? 0 : len;
  }

  function moveBlock(i, dir) {
    var lv = state.tree[i].lv, end = blockEnd(i);
    var block = state.tree.slice(i, end);
    if (dir < 0) {
      var p = i - 1;
      if (p < 0 || state.tree[p].lv !== lv) return;
      var prevBlock = state.tree.slice(p, i);
      state.tree.splice.apply(state.tree, [p, end - p].concat(prevBlock, block));
      state.olFocus = p;
    } else {
      if (end >= state.tree.length || state.tree[end].lv !== lv) return;
      var nNext = blockEnd(end), nextBlock = state.tree.slice(end, nNext);
      state.tree.splice.apply(state.tree, [i, nNext - i].concat(nextBlock, block));
      state.olFocus = i + nextBlock.length;
    }
    renderOutline(); focusRow(state.olFocus, true); updateHint();
  }

  qs("#olList").addEventListener("input", function (e) {
    var ta = e.target.closest(".ol-input"); if (!ta) return;
    state.tree[+ta.dataset.i].text = ta.value;
    autoGrow(ta);
    updateHint();
  });

  qs("#olList").addEventListener("focusin", function (e) {
    var ta = e.target.closest(".ol-input"); if (!ta) return;
    state.olFocus = +ta.dataset.i;
    state.olSel = state.tree[state.olFocus] ? state.tree[state.olFocus].id : null;
    qsa("#olList .ol-row").forEach(function (row) { row.classList.remove("on"); });
    var row = ta.closest(".ol-row");
    if (row) row.classList.add("on");
  });

  /* 幕布式条目键盘：Enter 拆行（光标后文字跟新行，有子级时落在整块之后）、
     Tab / Shift+Tab 整块缩进反缩进、方向键微调层级、空行 Backspace 删除 */
  qs("#olList").addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    var ta = e.target.closest(".ol-input"); if (!ta) return;
    var i = +ta.dataset.i, r = state.tree[i];
    if (!r) return;
    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      var head = ta.value.slice(0, ta.selectionStart);
      var tail = ta.value.slice(ta.selectionEnd);
      r.text = head;
      var at = blockEnd(i);   /* 当前行有子级时新行插到整块之后，避免抢占子级 */
      state.tree.splice(at, 0, newNode(r.lv, tail));
      state.olFocus = at;
      setDirty(true);
      renderOutline(); focusRow(at, false); updateHint();
    } else if (e.key === "Tab") {
      e.preventDefault();
      var ok = e.shiftKey ? outdentRow(i) : indentRow(i);   /* 缩进不超上一行+1，反缩进下限 0 */
      if (ok) { setDirty(true); renderOutline(); focusRow(i, true); updateHint(); }
    } else if (e.key === "Backspace" && !ta.value) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (state.tree.length > 1) {
        state.tree.splice(i, 1);
        state.olFocus = Math.max(0, i - 1);
        setDirty(true);
        renderOutline(); focusRow(state.olFocus, true);
      }
      updateHint();
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp" && i > 0) {
      e.preventDefault(); state.olFocus = i - 1; focusRow(i - 1, true);
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowDown" && i < state.tree.length - 1) {
      e.preventDefault(); state.olFocus = i + 1; focusRow(i + 1, true);
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" && ta.selectionStart === 0 && ta.selectionEnd === 0) {
      e.preventDefault(); if (outdentRow(i)) { setDirty(true); renderOutline(); focusRow(i, false); updateHint(); }
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowRight" && ta.selectionStart === ta.value.length && ta.selectionEnd === ta.value.length) {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (indentRow(i)) { setDirty(true); renderOutline(); focusRow(i, true); updateHint(); }
    }
  });

  /* 行内标签编辑：点行尾 chip → 就地输入 */
  function editTag(i, btn) {
    var inp = document.createElement("input");
    inp.className = "ol-tag-in";
    inp.value = state.tree[i].tag || "";
    inp.placeholder = "分类";
    inp.setAttribute("aria-label", "分类标签");
    btn.replaceWith(inp);
    inp.focus(); inp.select();
    var done = false;
    function commit(save) {
      if (done) return; done = true;
      if (save) state.tree[i].tag = inp.value.trim().replace(/^#/, "").slice(0, 12);
      renderOutline(); updateHint();
    }
    inp.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
      if (e.key === "Enter") { e.preventDefault(); commit(true); }
      else if (e.key === "Escape") { e.preventDefault(); commit(false); }
    });
    inp.addEventListener("blur", function () { commit(true); });
  }

  qs("#olList").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var act = e.target.closest("[data-act]"); if (!act) return;
    var row = act.closest(".ol-row"); if (!row) return;
    var i = +row.dataset.i;
    var a = act.dataset.act;
    if (a === "fold") { state.tree[i].folded = !state.tree[i].folded; renderOutline(); }
    else if (a === "check") { state.tree[i].done = !state.tree[i].done; renderOutline(); updateHint(); }
    else if (a === "pri") { state.tree[i].pri = ((state.tree[i].pri | 0) + 1) % 4; renderOutline(); updateHint(); }
    else if (a === "tag") { editTag(i, act); }
  });

  qs("#olIndent").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var i = state.olFocus;
    if (indentRow(i)) { setDirty(true); renderOutline(); focusRow(i, true); updateHint(); }
  });
  qs("#olOutdent").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var i = state.olFocus;
    if (outdentRow(i)) { setDirty(true); renderOutline(); focusRow(i, true); updateHint(); }
  });
  qs("#olUp").addEventListener("click", function () { moveBlock(state.olFocus, -1); });
  qs("#olDown").addEventListener("click", function () { moveBlock(state.olFocus, 1); });
  qs("#olAdd").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var i = state.olFocus, r = state.tree[i];
    var at = r ? i + 1 : 0;
    state.tree.splice(at, 0, newNode(r ? r.lv : 0, ""));
    state.olFocus = at;
    renderOutline(); focusRow(at, false); updateHint();
  });

  /* ---------- 拖右侧手柄排序：整块（含子级）落到目标行 ---------- */
  var olDrag = null;
  function indexOfRowId(id) {
    for (var i = 0; i < state.tree.length; i++) if (state.tree[i].id === id) return i;
    return -1;
  }
  function dropIndexAt(clientY) {
    var rows = qsa("#olList .ol-row");
    if (!rows.length) return 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
      var r = rows[i].getBoundingClientRect();
      if (clientY < r.top + r.height / 2) return +rows[i].dataset.i;
    }
    return blockEnd(+rows[rows.length - 1].dataset.i);
  }
  function moveBlockTo(from, to) {
    var lv = state.tree[from].lv, end = blockEnd(from);
    var block = state.tree.slice(from, end);
    var rest = state.tree.slice(0, from).concat(state.tree.slice(end));
    var t = to > from ? to - block.length : to;
    t = Math.max(0, Math.min(rest.length, t));
    state.tree = rest.slice(0, t).concat(block, rest.slice(t));
    /* 层级合法化：新位置上一行即「新父行」，块根不得深过 父行+1（拖到顶视为父行 -1 级）；
       深了就整块统一上提（负向平移），块内相对层级不变，后代一并夹回合法范围 */
    var prev = t > 0 ? state.tree[t - 1] : null;
    var pl = prev ? prev.lv : -1;
    if (pl < lv) {
      var d = Math.min(4, pl + 1) - lv;
      for (var k = t; k < t + block.length; k++) state.tree[k].lv = Math.max(0, state.tree[k].lv + d);
    }
    state.olFocus = t;
  }
  /* 拖拽指示线：标到目标行上缘；落到列表末尾时标在最后一行下缘（.drop-end） */
  function markDropLine(to) {
    qsa("#olList .ol-row").forEach(function (r) { r.classList.remove("drop-line", "drop-end"); });
    if (to < 0) return;
    var el = qs('#olList .ol-row[data-i="' + to + '"]');
    if (el) { el.classList.add("drop-line"); return; }
    var rows = qsa("#olList .ol-row");
    if (rows.length) rows[rows.length - 1].classList.add("drop-line", "drop-end");
  }

  qs("#olList").addEventListener("pointerdown", function (e) {
    var grip = e.target.closest(".ol-grip");
    if (!grip) return;
    var row = grip.closest(".ol-row");
    if (!row) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    olDrag = { id: state.tree[+row.dataset.i].id, moved: false };
    qs("#olList").classList.add("dragging");
    if (qs("#olList").setPointerCapture) qs("#olList").setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });

  qs("#olList").addEventListener("pointermove", function (e) {
    if (!olDrag) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    var from = indexOfRowId(olDrag.id);
    if (from < 0) return;
    var to = dropIndexAt(e.clientY), end = blockEnd(from);
    if (to > from && to < end) { markDropLine(-1); return; }   /* 落在自己块内：无意义 */
    if (to !== from && to !== end) {
      moveBlockTo(from, to);
      renderOutline();
      var row = qs('#olList .ol-row[data-i="' + state.olFocus + '"]');
      if (row) row.classList.add("dragging");
      olDrag.moved = true;
      markDropLine(dropIndexAt(e.clientY));   /* 移动后行号已变，按当前布局重算指示位置 */
      updateHint();
    } else {
      markDropLine(to);
    }
  });

  function endOlDrag() {
    if (!olDrag) return;
    var moved = olDrag.moved;
    olDrag = null;
    qs("#olList").classList.remove("dragging");
    state.olSel = state.tree[state.olFocus] ? state.tree[state.olFocus].id : null;
    renderOutline();
    if (moved) setDirty(true);   /* 拖拽改了结构，走既有 2.5s 自动保存链路 */
  }
  qs("#olList").addEventListener("pointerup", endOlDrag);
  qs("#olList").addEventListener("pointercancel", endOlDrag);

  /* ============================================================
     二、思维导图（同一棵树的图形视图）
     ============================================================ */
  function nodeBox(n) {
    var w = Math.max(78, String(n.text || "").length * 13 + 26);
    return { w: w, h: 30 };
  }
  function mmToWorld(cx, cy) {
    var r = qs("#mmStage").getBoundingClientRect(), v = state.mmView;
    return { x: (cx - r.left - v.x) / v.k, y: (cy - r.top - v.y) / v.k };
  }

  /* 由树自动布局出一张脑图；root 的文案取笔记标题 */
  function mindFromTree(rows, rootText) {
    var nodes = [{ id: "m0", text: rootText || "中心主题", x: 0, y: 0, parent: null }];
    var stack = [{ lv: -1, id: "m0" }], depth = { m0: 0 }, seq = 1;
    rows.forEach(function (r) {
      while (stack.length > 1 && stack[stack.length - 1].lv >= r.lv) stack.pop();
      var parent = stack[stack.length - 1].id;
      var id = "m" + (seq++);
      nodes.push({ id: id, text: (r.text || "").trim() || "…", x: 0, y: 0, parent: parent });
      depth[id] = depth[parent] + 1;
      stack.push({ lv: r.lv, id: id });
    });
    var kids = {};
    nodes.forEach(function (n) { (kids[n.parent] = kids[n.parent] || []).push(n.id); });
    var cursor = 0, y = {};
    function walk(id) {
      var ch = kids[id] || [];
      if (!ch.length) { y[id] = cursor; cursor += 62; return y[id]; }
      var ys = ch.map(walk);
      y[id] = (ys[0] + ys[ys.length - 1]) / 2;
      return y[id];
    }
    walk("m0");
    nodes.forEach(function (n) { n.x = depth[n.id] * 208; n.y = y[n.id]; });
    return { root: "m0", nodes: nodes };
  }

  /* 脑图节点的文档序（数组插入序 = 树序，拖动只改坐标不改序） */
  function mindOrder(mind) {
    if (!mind || !mind.nodes || !mind.nodes.length) return [];
    var kids = {};
    mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) { (kids[n.parent] = kids[n.parent] || []).push(n); });
    var out = [];
    (function walk(id) {
      (kids[id] || []).forEach(function (c) { out.push(c.id); walk(c.id); });
    })(mind.root);
    return out;
  }
  function treeIndexOfMind(id) { return mindOrder(state.mind).indexOf(id); }

  /* 结构一致则只同步文案、保留手动位置；结构变了则重新布局 */
  function syncMind() {
    var order = mindOrder(state.mind);
    var same = order.length === state.tree.length && state.tree.length > 0;
    if (same) {
      var byId = {};
      state.mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) { byId[n.id] = n; });
      var depth = {};
      function d(id) {
        if (depth[id] != null) return depth[id];
        var n = byId[id];
        depth[id] = (!n || !n.parent || !byId[n.parent]) ? 0 : d(n.parent) + 1;
        return depth[id];
      }
      for (var i = 0; i < state.tree.length; i++) {
        var mn = byId[order[i]];
        if (!mn || (d(order[i]) - 1) !== state.tree[i].lv) { same = false; break; }
      }
      if (same) {
        for (var j = 0; j < state.tree.length; j++) {
          byId[order[j]].text = (state.tree[j].text || "").trim() || "…";
        }
        if (!state.mmSel || !mindNode(state.mmSel)) state.mmSel = state.mind.root;
        return false;
      }
    }
    state.mind = state.tree.length ? mindFromTree(state.tree, titleText()) : null;
    state.mmSel = state.mind ? state.mind.root : null;
    return !!state.mind;
  }

  function renderMind() {
    var svg = qs("#mmSvg"), mind = state.mind;
    if (!mind || !mind.nodes || !mind.nodes.length) {
      svg.innerHTML = "";
      qs("#mmEmpty").style.display = "grid";
      return;
    }
    qs("#mmEmpty").style.display = "none";
    var byId = {}; mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) { byId[n.id] = n; });
    var v = state.mmView;
    var out = '<g transform="translate(' + v.x + ',' + v.y + ') scale(' + v.k + ')">';
    mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) {
      if (!n.parent || !byId[n.parent]) return;
      var p = byId[n.parent], pb = nodeBox(p), nb = nodeBox(n);
      var x1 = p.x + pb.w, y1 = p.y + pb.h / 2, x2 = n.x, y2 = n.y + nb.h / 2, mx = (x1 + x2) / 2;
      out += '<path class="mm-edge" d="M' + x1 + " " + y1 + " C" + mx + " " + y1 + " " + mx + " " + y2 + " " + x2 + " " + y2 + '"/>';
    });
    mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) {
      var b = nodeBox(n);
      out += '<g class="mm-node' + (n.id === mind.root ? " root" : "") + (n.id === state.mmSel ? " sel" : "") + '" data-id="' + n.id + '" transform="translate(' + n.x + "," + n.y + ')">' +
        '<rect width="' + b.w + '" height="' + b.h + '" rx="3"/>' +
        '<text x="' + b.w / 2 + '" y="' + (b.h / 2 + 4) + '" text-anchor="middle">' + esc(n.text) + "</text>" +
        '<g class="mm-plus" data-add="' + n.id + '" transform="translate(' + (b.w + 10) + "," + (b.h / 2) + ')">' +
        '<circle r="8"/><line x1="-4" x2="4" y1="0" y2="0"/><line x1="0" x2="0" y1="-4" y2="4"/></g>' +
        "</g>";
    });
    out += "</g>";
    svg.innerHTML = out;
    qs("#mmZoomVal").textContent = Math.round(v.k * 100) + "%";
  }

  function fitMind() {
    if (!state.mind || !state.mind.nodes.length) return;
    var stage = qs("#mmStage");
    var W = stage.clientWidth || 640, H = stage.clientHeight || 470;
    var minX = 1e9, minY = 1e9, maxX = -1e9, maxY = -1e9;
    state.mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) {
      var b = nodeBox(n);
      minX = Math.min(minX, n.x); minY = Math.min(minY, n.y);
      maxX = Math.max(maxX, n.x + b.w); maxY = Math.max(maxY, n.y + b.h);
    });
    var pad = 64;
    var k = Math.min(1.15, Math.min((W - pad * 2) / Math.max(1, maxX - minX), (H - pad * 2) / Math.max(1, maxY - minY)));
    k = Math.max(0.35, k);
    state.mmView.k = k;
    state.mmView.x = (W - (maxX - minX) * k) / 2 - minX * k;
    state.mmView.y = (H - (maxY - minY) * k) / 2 - minY * k;
  }

  function selectNode(id) {
    state.mmSel = id;
    var n = mindNode(id);
    qs("#mmEdit").value = n ? n.text : "";
    renderMind();
  }

  /* 脑图新增子节点 → 写回树（树为真相），随后重新布局 */
  function mmAddChild(parentId) {
    var order = mindOrder(state.mind);
    var pIdx = order.indexOf(parentId);
    var insertAt, lv;
    if (pIdx < 0) { insertAt = state.tree.length; lv = 0; }
    else { insertAt = blockEnd(pIdx); lv = Math.min(4, state.tree[pIdx].lv + 1); }
    state.tree.splice(insertAt, 0, newNode(lv, "新节点"));
    syncMind(); fitMind();
    var order2 = mindOrder(state.mind);
    selectNode(order2[insertAt]);
    renderOutline(); updateHint();
    qs("#mmEdit").focus(); qs("#mmEdit").select();
  }

  /* 脑图删除节点 → 子树整体上提一级（与树的层级语义一致） */
  function mmDelNode() {
    if (!state.mind || !state.mmSel) return;
    if (state.mmSel === state.mind.root) { toast("根节点不可删除", "alert-triangle"); return; }
    var idx = treeIndexOfMind(state.mmSel);
    if (idx < 0) return;
    var lv = state.tree[idx].lv;
    state.tree.splice(idx, 1);
    for (var j = idx; j < state.tree.length; j++) {
      if (state.tree[j].lv > lv) state.tree[j].lv--; else break;
    }
    state.mmSel = null;
    syncMind(); fitMind(); renderMind(); renderOutline(); updateHint();
  }

  /* 按脑图布局（先 y 后 x 的中序）重排大纲 */
  function reorderByMind() {
    if (!state.mind) return;
    var byId = {}; state.mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) { byId[n.id] = n; });
    var kids = {};
    state.mind.nodes.forEach(function (n) { (kids[n.parent] = kids[n.parent] || []).push(n); });
    var rows = [];
    (function walk(id, lv) {
      (kids[id] || []).slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.y - b.y || a.x - b.x; }).forEach(function (c) {
        var idx = treeIndexOfMind(c.id);
        var r = idx >= 0 ? state.tree[idx] : null;
        if (r) { r.lv = Math.min(4, lv); rows.push(r); }
        walk(c.id, lv + 1);
      });
    })(state.mind.root, 0);
    if (rows.length !== state.tree.length) { toast("脑图与大纲条目不一致，先补齐再重排", "alert-triangle"); return; }
    /* v2.11 Bug2：重排前快照整棵树 —— toast 带「撤销」（MD3 Snackbar Undo），一键还原 */
    var before = state.tree.map(function (r) { return Object.assign({}, r); });
    state.tree = rows;
    syncMind(); renderMind(); renderOutline(); updateHint();
    setDirty(true);   /* 重排也走既有 2.5s 自动保存链路 */
    toast("已按脑图布局重排大纲", "list-tree", function () {
      state.tree = before.map(function (r) { return Object.assign({}, r); });
      syncMind(); renderMind(); renderOutline(); updateHint();
      setDirty(true);
      toast("已撤销重排", "undo-2");
    });
  }

  qs("#mmEdit").addEventListener("input", function () {
    var idx = treeIndexOfMind(state.mmSel);
    if (idx < 0) return;
    var v = qs("#mmEdit").value;
    state.tree[idx].text = v;
    var n = mindNode(state.mmSel); if (n) n.text = v || "…";
    renderMind(); updateHint();
  });
  qs("#mmAdd").addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (!state.tree.length) {
      state.tree.push(newNode(0, "新节点"));
      syncMind(); fitMind(); renderMind();
      selectNode(mindOrder(state.mind)[0]);
      renderOutline(); updateHint();
      qs("#mmEdit").focus(); qs("#mmEdit").select();
      return;
    }
    mmAddChild(state.mmSel || state.mind.root);
  });
  qs("#mmDel").addEventListener("click", mmDelNode);
  qs("#mmOrder").addEventListener("click", reorderByMind);
  qs("#mmZoomIn").addEventListener("click", function () { mmZoom(1.15); });
  qs("#mmZoomOut").addEventListener("click", function () { mmZoom(0.87); });
  qs("#mmFit").addEventListener("click", function () { fitMind(); renderMind(); });

  function mmZoom(f) {
    if (!state.mind) return;
    var v = state.mmView, stage = qs("#mmStage");
    var mx = stage.clientWidth / 2, my = stage.clientHeight / 2;
    var k2 = Math.min(2.4, Math.max(0.35, v.k * f));
    v.x = mx - (mx - v.x) * (k2 / v.k);
    v.y = my - (my - v.y) * (k2 / v.k);
    v.k = k2;
    renderMind();
  }

  qs("#mmStage").addEventListener("pointerdown", function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest(".mm-tools, .mm-zoom")) return;
    var add = e.target.closest(".mm-plus");
    if (add) { e.preventDefault(); mmAddChild(add.dataset.add); return; }
    var node = e.target.closest(".mm-node");
    if (node) {
      var id = node.dataset.id;
      selectNode(id);
      var w = mmToWorld(e.clientX, e.clientY), n = mindNode(id);
      state.mmDrag = { kind: "node", id: id, dx: n.x - w.x, dy: n.y - w.y };
      if (qs("#mmStage").setPointerCapture) qs("#mmStage").setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
      return;
    }
    if (!state.mind || !state.mind.nodes.length) return;
    state.mmDrag = { kind: "pan", sx: e.clientX, sy: e.clientY, vx: state.mmView.x, vy: state.mmView.y };
    qs("#mmStage").classList.add("panning");
    if (qs("#mmStage").setPointerCapture) qs("#mmStage").setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });

  qs("#mmStage").addEventListener("pointermove", function (e) {
    var d = state.mmDrag; if (!d) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (d.kind === "pan") {
      state.mmView.x = d.vx + (e.clientX - d.sx);
      state.mmView.y = d.vy + (e.clientY - d.sy);
      renderMind();
    } else {
      var w = mmToWorld(e.clientX, e.clientY), n = mindNode(d.id);
      if (n) { n.x = Math.round(w.x + d.dx); n.y = Math.round(w.y + d.dy); renderMind(); }
    }
  });

  function endMmDrag() {
    if (!state.mmDrag) return;
    qs("#mmStage").classList.remove("panning");
    state.mmDrag = null;
  }
  qs("#mmStage").addEventListener("pointerup", endMmDrag);
  qs("#mmStage").addEventListener("pointercancel", endMmDrag);

  qs("#mmStage").addEventListener("wheel", function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest(".mm-tools, .mm-zoom")) return;
    if (!state.mind || !state.mind.nodes.length) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    var v = state.mmView, r = qs("#mmStage").getBoundingClientRect();
    var mx = e.clientX - r.left, my = e.clientY - r.top;
    var k2 = Math.min(2.4, Math.max(0.35, v.k * (e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.12 : 0.89)));
    v.x = mx - (mx - v.x) * (k2 / v.k);
    v.y = my - (my - v.y) * (k2 / v.k);
    v.k = k2;
    renderMind();
  }, { passive: false });

  qs("#mmStage").addEventListener("dblclick", function (e) {
    if (e.target.closest(".mm-node, .mm-plus, .mm-tools, .mm-zoom")) return;
    var w = mmToWorld(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    var first = !state.tree.length;
    state.tree.push(newNode(0, "新节点"));
    syncMind();
    if (first) fitMind();
    var order = mindOrder(state.mind);
    var nid = order[order.length - 1];
    var mn = mindNode(nid);
    if (mn && !first) { mn.x = Math.round(w.x); mn.y = Math.round(w.y); }
    selectNode(nid);
    renderOutline(); updateHint();
    qs("#mmEdit").focus(); qs("#mmEdit").select();
  });

  /* ============================================================
     三、Markdown · LaTeX（树的实时序列化）
     ============================================================ */
  function syncPreview() {
    qs("#preview").innerHTML = MD.render(qs("#mdEditor").value) || '<span class="ef-hint">预览区（空）</span>';
  }
  qs("#mdEditor").addEventListener("input", function () {
    syncPreview();
    clearTimeout(state.mdTimer);
    state.mdTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      state.tree = parse(qs("#mdEditor").value);
      updateHint();
    }, 300);
  });

  /* data-md 工具钮与 Ctrl+B / I / K 快捷键共用的插入逻辑（原点击逻辑原样提取） */
  function applyMd(mk) {
    var ta = qs("#mdEditor");
    var s = ta.selectionStart, e = ta.selectionEnd, v = ta.value, sel = v.slice(s, e);
    var ins;
    if (mk === "table") ins = "\n| 列 A | 列 B |\n| --- | --- |\n| 值 1 | 值 2 |\n";
    else if (mk === "$$") ins = "\n$$\n" + (sel || "C_{total}=\\alpha\\bar{t}+\\beta r+\\gamma L") + "\n$$\n";
    else if (mk === "[文字](链接)") ins = "[" + (sel || "文字") + "](https://)";
    else if (mk === "`") ins = "`" + (sel || "code") + "`";
    else if (mk === "## " || mk === "- " || mk === "1. " || mk === "> ") ins = mk + (sel || "内容");
    else ins = mk + (sel || "文本") + mk;
    ta.value = v.slice(0, s) + ins + v.slice(e);
    ta.focus();
    ta.selectionStart = ta.selectionEnd = s + ins.length;
    syncPreview();
    state.tree = parse(ta.value);
    updateHint();
    setDirty(true);
    if (imm.on) setTimeout(centerCaret, 0);
  }

  qsa("[data-md]").forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener("click", function () { applyMd(b.dataset.md); });
  });

  /* ---------- Typora 式快捷键：Ctrl/Cmd+B 加粗 · I 斜体 · K 链接 · Tab 列表缩进 ---------- */
  qs("#mdEditor").addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && !e.altKey && !e.shiftKey) {
      var k = (e.key || "").toLowerCase();
      if (k === "b") { e.preventDefault(); applyMd("**"); return; }
      if (k === "i") { e.preventDefault(); applyMd("*"); return; }
      if (k === "k") { e.preventDefault(); applyMd("[文字](链接)"); return; }
    }
    if (e.key === "Tab" && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      mdIndent(e.shiftKey);
    }
  });

  /* Tab / Shift+Tab：列表行（- 、1. 、> 前缀）插 / 移两空格缩进（多行选区整块生效）；
     普通行 Tab 在光标处插两空格（阻止默认失焦）；Shift+Tab 无处可退时不动 */
  function mdIndent(outdent) {
    var ta = qs("#mdEditor");
    var v = ta.value, s = ta.selectionStart, e2 = ta.selectionEnd;
    var ls = v.lastIndexOf("\n", s - 1) + 1;                    /* 选区首行行首 */
    var le = v.indexOf("\n", e2); if (le < 0) le = v.length;    /* 选区末行行尾 */
    var lines = v.slice(ls, le).split("\n");
    var multi = lines.length > 1;
    var first = lines[0];
    var isList = /^(\s*)(?:[-*+]|\d+\.)\s/.test(first) || /^(\s*)>\s/.test(first);

    if (!outdent && !isList && !multi) {
      ta.value = v.slice(0, s) + "  " + v.slice(e2);
      ta.selectionStart = ta.selectionEnd = s + 2;
    } else if (isList || (outdent && /^\s/.test(first))) {
      var d1 = 0;
      var nl = lines.map(function (l, ix) {
        if (!l.trim()) return l;                                /* 空行不动 */
        if (outdent) {
          var m = l.match(/^ {1,2}/), rm = m ? m[0].length : 0;
          if (ix === 0) d1 = -rm;
          return l.slice(rm);
        }
        if (ix === 0) d1 = 2;
        return "  " + l;
      }).join("\n");
      ta.value = v.slice(0, ls) + nl + v.slice(le);
      if (multi) ta.setSelectionRange(ls, ls + nl.length);
      else ta.setSelectionRange(Math.max(ls, s + d1), Math.max(ls, e2 + d1));
    } else {
      return;
    }
    syncPreview();
    state.tree = parse(ta.value);
    updateHint();
    setDirty(true);
    if (imm.on) setTimeout(centerCaret, 0);
  }

  qs("#btnPreview").addEventListener("click", function () {
    var split = qs("#mdSplit");
    var only = split.classList.toggle("preview-only");
    qs("#btnPreview").classList.toggle("active", only);
    if (only) syncPreview();
  });

  /* ---------- B2 专注模式（v2.10 · 真·跟随光标） ----------
     语义与 Typora 的 on-focus-mode 一致：当前段落正常、其余淡出、随光标走。
     编辑器侧用「镜像测量 + 覆盖高亮带」实现（textarea 无法按段着色），
     预览/大纲侧按块降灰并点亮命中项。偏好键沿用 inkread.mdfocus.v1（旧值直接兼容）。 */
  var LS_MDFOCUS = "inkread.mdfocus.v1";
  var mdBand = null, mdMirror = null, mdRaf = 0;
  function mdFocusOn() { return document.body.classList.contains("md-focus"); }

  function mdFocusNodes() {
    if (mdBand) return;
